title_en: Russian An-12 transport crashes in southern Siberia
title_zh: 俄罗斯An-12运输机在西伯利亚南部坠毁
summary: Russian media reports an ignited fuel leak is under scrutiny as one potential cause of the fiery crash. A Russian Antonov An-12 military transport aircraft has gone down in the Kemerovo region of Siberia, killing 17 people. State broadcaster Ren TV confirmed b

body_en: Russian media reports an ignited fuel leak is under scrutiny as one potential cause of the fiery crash.
A Russian Antonov An-12 military transport aircraft has gone down in the Kemerovo region of Siberia, killing 17 people.
State broadcaster Ren TV confirmed both the 17 November crash and the fatality figure. The incident occurred near the town of Yagunovo at around 21:30 local time.

An unverified video circulating on social media shows an object falling from the night sky on an extreme vertical trajectory. Although little can be discerned from the black-and-white footage, the object appears to be on fire and trailing both flame and smoke.
A large explosion can be seen shortly after impact.

In a video from the crash site, governor of the Kemerovo region Ilya Seredyuk said first responders are on site, including personnel from the Ministry of Emergency Situations, police, and Russia’s Rosgvardia national guard.
The aircraft was reportedly en route from the city of Novosibirsk to Kansk in the Krasnoyarsk Krai region.
A Russian Air Force An-12 cargo aircraft reportedly crashed in Kemerovo, Siberia, this evening. https://t.co/HCxbKJIh5S
OSINTtechnical (@Osinttechnical) November 17, 2026

According to Russian news outlet Baza, the incident An-12 requested an emergency landing in Kemerovo, approximately a quarter of the way through its flight to Kansk. Although a cause is not yet known, Baza claims authorities are pursuing three potential culprits: a fuel pump malfunction; a fuel leak in the engine nacelle, followed by a fire; and a hydraulic system failure.

“The fuel in the engine likely ignited during flight,” Baza reports. “The fire caused the high-wing structural system to fail, causing the aircraft to plummet and crash approximately 5km from the Kemerovo airport.”
Prior to the crash, the Russian air force operated a fleet of 54 An-12 transports, with five more operated by Russian Naval Aviation.

The fleet is significantly aged, with an average age of 56 years. Data from aviation analytics company Cirium suggests most of the Russian An-12s were assembled in the late 1960s and early 1970s at the Tashkent Vostochny production site in Uzbekistan during the Soviet period.
The post Russian An-12 transport crashes in southern Siberia first appeared on FlightGlobal .
body_zh: 俄罗斯媒体报道称，起火的燃油泄漏正在接受审查，认为这是造成这场大火的潜在原因之一。
一架俄罗斯安东诺夫An-12军用运输机在西伯利亚克麦罗沃地区坠毁，造成17人死亡。
国家电视台仁视电视台证实了 11 月 17 日的事故和死亡人数。这起事件发生在当地时间21时30分左右，发生在亚古诺沃镇附近。
社交媒体上流传的一段未经证实的视频显示，一个物体以极端垂直的轨迹从夜空中坠落。尽管从黑白镜头中看不到什么，但该物体似乎着火了，并拖着火焰和烟雾。
撞击后不久即可看到大爆炸。
在坠机现场的一段视频中，克麦罗沃地区州长伊利亚·谢雷杜克表示，现场有急救人员，包括紧急情况部人员、警察和俄罗斯罗斯格瓦尔迪亚国民警卫队。
据报道，这架飞机当时正从新西伯利亚市飞往克拉斯诺亚尔斯克边疆区的坎斯克。
据报道，俄罗斯空军一架 An-12 货机今晚在西伯利亚克麦罗沃坠毁。 https://t.co/HCxbKJIh5S
OSINTtechnical (@Osinttechnical) 2026 年 11 月 17 日
据俄罗斯新闻媒体 Baza 报道，发生事故的 An-12 要求在克麦罗沃紧急迫降，此时距其飞往坎斯克的航程大约已完成四分之一。尽管原因尚不清楚，但巴扎声称当局正在追查三个潜在的罪魁祸首：燃油泵故障；发动机机舱燃油泄漏，随后引发火灾；以及液压系统故障。
“发动机中的燃油可能在飞行过程中被点燃，”巴扎报告说。 “火灾导致高翼结构系统失效，导致飞机垂直坠落并坠毁在距离克麦罗沃机场约5公里处。”
事故发生前，俄罗斯空军运营着一支由 54 架 An-12 运输机组成的机队，其中还有 5 架由俄罗斯海军航空兵运营。
机队老化明显，平均机龄为56年。航空分析公司 Cirium 的数据表明，大多数俄罗斯 An-12 是在 20 世纪 60 年代末和 1970 年代初苏联时期在乌兹别克斯坦塔什干东方生产基地组装的。
俄罗斯 An-12 运输机在西伯利亚南部坠毁后的事件首先出现在 FlightGlobal 上。

title_en: Finnish satellite firm Iceye seeks to acquire Vega launch vehicle developer Avio
title_zh: 芬兰卫星公司 Iceye 寻求收购 Vega 运载火箭开发商 Avio
summary: Combination intended to establish vertically-integrated firm to meet increasing European demand for sovereign space and defence capability. Italian space propulsion company Avio has become the target of a takeover bid from the Finnish intelligence satellite fi
summary_zh: 合并旨在建立垂直整合的公司，以满足欧洲对主权太空和国防能力日益增长的需求。意大利sp
body_en: Combination intended to establish vertically-integrated firm to meet increasing European demand for sovereign space and defence capability.
Italian space propulsion company Avio has become the target of a takeover bid from the Finnish intelligence satellite firm Iceye.

Iceye has proposed an all-cash voluntary offer of €41 per share for the entire share capital of Avio. Given that just over 50 million shares are involved, this values Avio at more than €2 billion ($2.2 billion).
Combination of the companies would bring Avio’s launch and propulsion capability together with Iceye’s satellite manufacturing and constellation operation activities.
This would enable Icye to obtain “more reliable access to launch” as it deals with increasing demand for its services.
Iceye specialises in providing satellite-based Earth imagery and intelligence to governments and other customers, for defence, environmental monitoring, insurance and catastrophe management.
“Avio has built the launch and propulsion capability Europe relies on,” says Iceye chief Rafal Modrzewski.
“With Iceye’s long-term capital behind it, we can integrate the supply chain, grow output and strengthen the European programmes that already depend on it.”

Avio, based at Colleferro near Rome, developed the four-stage Vega launch vehicle – with three solid-fuelled and one liquid-fuelled stage – intended to give Europe independent access for lighter payloads.
This craft first flew in February 2012 and it carried out 22 flights before evolving into the Vega-C which launched in July 2022.
Avio is planning a further development, the Vega-E, which will have a different stack configuration, with the third and fourth stages replaced by a cryogenic liquid-fuelled upper stage.
The manufacturer says it has “taken note” of the Iceye offer, which is being conducted through a Milan-based Iceye subsidiary called Iris 2.
Avio’s board has “started the activities for the assessment of the offer”, it adds.
Iceye specialises in space-based radar and launch the first sub-100kg synthetic aperture radar satellite in 2018. It operates the largest constellation of such satellites, with more than 80 launched.
It says the proposed tie-up with Avio is driven by a desire to “build a vertically-integrated European space and defence company”.
Europe has a “growing” need for sovereign space and defence capabilities, it argues.
“Building the industrial capacity to meet that demand takes years, which makes it critical to invest now,” says Iceye.
It plans to invest another €1 billion in Italy over the five years post-completion, in order to increase the Vega launch cadence and expand Avio’s industrial capacity.

Avio’s brand would be retained and Iceye says the acquisition would give the Italian firm greater visibility on demand, along with the investment in production and more frequent launches – expanding capacity for institutional and commercial customers.
The post Finnish satellite firm Iceye seeks to acquire Vega launch vehicle developer Avio first appeared on FlightGlobal .
body_zh: 合并旨在建立垂直整合的公司，以满足欧洲对主权太空和国防能力日益增长的需求。
意大利太空推进公司 Avio 已成为芬兰情报卫星公司 Iceye 的收购目标。
Iceye 提议以每股 41 欧元的全现金自愿要约收购 Avio 的全部股本。鉴于涉及的股票数量略多于 5000 万股，Avio 的估值超过 20 亿欧元（22 亿美元）。
两家公司的合并将把 Avio 的发射和推进能力与 Iceye 的卫星制造和星座运营活动结合起来。
这将使 Icye 能够在应对日益增长的服务需求时获得“更可靠的启动渠道”。
Iceye 专门为政府和其他客户提供基于卫星的地球图像和情报，用于国防、环境监测、保险和灾难管理。
“Avio 已经建立了欧洲所依赖的发射和推进能力，”Iceye 首席执行官 Rafal Modrzewski 表示。
“有了 Iceye 的长期资本支持，我们可以整合供应链、增加产量并加强已经依赖它的欧洲项目。”
Avio 总部位于罗马附近的科莱费罗，开发了四级织女星运载火箭（具有三级固体燃料和一级液体燃料），旨在让欧洲能够独立获得更轻的有效载荷。
该飞行器于 2012 年 2 月首飞，并进行了 22 次飞行，之后演变成 2022 年 7 月发射的 Vega-C。
Avio 正在计划进一步开发 Vega-E，它将具有不同的堆栈配置，第三和第四级被低温液体燃料的上级取代。
该制造商表示，它已经“注意到”了 Iceye 的报价，该报价是通过位于米兰的 Iceye 子公司 Iris 2 进行的。
它补充说，Avio 董事会已“开始评估要约的活动”。
Iceye专注于天基雷达，并于2018年发射了第一颗低于100公斤的合成孔径雷达卫星。它运营着此类卫星中最大的星座，已发射了80多颗。
该公司表示，与 Avio 的拟议合作是出于“建立一家垂直整合的欧洲太空和国防公司”的愿望。
它认为，欧洲对主权太空和防御能力的需求“日益增长”。
Iceye 表示：“建设满足这一需求的工业能力需要数年时间，因此现在就进行投资至关重要。”
该公司计划在竣工后的五年内在意大利再投资 10 亿欧元，以加快 Vega 的发射节奏并扩大 Avio 的工业产能。
Avio 的品牌将被保留，Iceye 表示，此次收购将为这家意大利公司带来更大的需求知名度，以及对生产的投资和更频繁的发布，从而扩大机构和商业客户的产能。
后芬兰卫星公司 Iceye 寻求收购 Vega 运载火箭开发商 Avio 首次出现在 FlightGlobal 上。

title_en: FBI joins investigation into FAA router failure amid hacking concern
title_zh: 由于担心黑客攻击，FBI 加入对 FAA 路由器故障的调查
summary: The US aviation regulator is unsure why router functions that caused the system failures became activated, but has no evidence yet of hacking. The US Department of Transportation (DOT) has asked the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) to help analyse the rou
summary_zh: 美国航空监管机构不确定导致系统故障的路由器功能为何被激活，但尚未有黑客攻击的证据。美国
body_en: The US aviation regulator is unsure why router functions that caused the system failures became activated, but has no evidence yet of hacking.

The US Department of Transportation (DOT) has asked the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) to help analyse the router that caused last week’s air traffic control system (ATC) failure, amid concern about hacking.
Speaking on 17 November, DOT secretary Sean Duffy insists he has no evidence of hacking and that experts have told him the FAA was not hacked.

Meanwhile, Federal Aviation Administration chief Bryan Bedford says the agency thought it had disabled functions on the router, made by a company called Juniper, that caused the problems. Those functions activated for reasons still unknown.

“I asked [FBI director Kash Patel] to send me part of his FBI team, to be part of the analysing of this router,” Duffy says. “All of my intelligence partners are telling us that [a hacking] is not the case, but we have the FBI there partnering with us as we work through this analysis.”

The problem happened on 13 November amid a project by FAA contractor L3Harris to replace copper wires with fibre-optic wires and to install a new router. That device started “flooding other routers” by making “1,000 connection attempts every four or five seconds”, Duffy previously said. That overwhelmed the legacy systems.
The FAA mostly uses Cisco routers but has started using Juniper models. Prior to doing so, it spent a year testing the new equipment, Bedford says.
He confirms the Juniper routers can “be enabled to do what it did” to cause the problem.

“We thought we had that technology turned off. We thought we had it disabled in the configuration,” Bedford says. “There is some uncertainty today [about] how the configuration changed in a way that allowed this multi-casting to become effective.”
“We’ve seen nothing in how the configuration on that device was changed by the installation,” he adds.
The FAA had previously installed 68 of the Juniper routers and has since removed all from use.

The problem caused ATC radar and air-to-ground communication failures at 17 of 22 FAA Air Route Traffic Control sites, with Bedford saying controllers needed to continually switch between primary and backup systems.
Within an hour, problems “began to trickle into the terminal environment, which is a completely different system”, Bedford adds. Terminal controllers manage flights near airports.
The FAA responded by issuing a ground stop that lasted about 4h, forcing airlines to cancel thousands of flights and causing a nationwide air travel meltdown.
The router that caused the problems is now being studied at an L3Harris site in Florida.
The post FBI joins investigation into FAA router failure amid hacking concern first appeared on FlightGlobal .
body_zh: 美国航空监管机构不确定导致系统故障的路由器功能为何被激活，但尚未有黑客攻击的证据。
由于担心黑客攻击，美国交通部 (DOT) 已要求联邦调查局 (FBI) 帮助分析导致上周空中交通管制系统 (ATC) 故障的路由器。
11 月 17 日，交通部部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 坚称，他没有任何黑客攻击的证据，而且专家告诉他，美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 并未遭到黑客攻击。
与此同时，美国联邦航空管理局局长布莱恩·贝德福德 (Bryan Bedford) 表示，该机构认为是由瞻博网络 (Juniper) 公司制造的路由器功能被禁用，从而导致了问题。这些功能被激活的原因尚不清楚。
“我要求 [FBI 局长 Kash Patel] 派我加入他的 FBI 团队，参与对这个路由器的分析，”Duffy 说。 “我所有的情报合作伙伴都告诉我们，[黑客攻击]并非如此，但在我们进行分析时，联邦调查局正在与我们合作。”
该问题发生于 11 月 13 日，当时 FAA 承包商 L3Harris 正在执行一项用光纤线取代铜线并安装新路由器的项目。达菲此前表示，该设备“每四到五秒进行 1000 次连接尝试”，开始“淹没其他路由器”。这压垮了遗留系统。
FAA 主要使用 Cisco 路由器，但已开始使用 Juniper 型号。贝德福德说，在此之前，它花了一年的时间测试新设备。
他确认瞻博网络路由器可以“被启用做它所做的事情”来导致问题。
“我们认为我们已经关闭了这项技术。我们认为我们已经在配置中禁用了它，”贝德福德说。 “目前，配置如何改变才能使多播变得有效还存在一些不确定性。”
“我们没有看到安装如何改变该设备上的配置，”他补充道。
FAA 此前安装了 68 个瞻博网络路由器，此后已将所有路由器停止使用。
该问题导致 FAA 22 个空中航线交通管制站点中的 17 个出现 ATC 雷达和空对地通信故障，贝德福德表示，管制员需要在主系统和备用系统之间不断切换。
贝德福德补充道，一个小时内，问题“开始渗透到终端环境中，这是一个完全不同的系统”。航站楼管制员管理机场附近的航班。
作为回应，美国联邦航空局发布了持续约 4 小时的地面停飞，迫使航空公司取消数千个航班，并导致全国范围内的航空旅行崩溃。
造成问题的路由器目前正在佛罗里达州的 L3Harris 站点进行研究。
联邦调查局 (FBI) 参与调查美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 路由器因黑客攻击而出现故障的消息首先出现在 FlightGlobal 上。

title_en: US lawmakers agree to mandate ADS-B In collision-avoidance system
title_zh: 美国立法者同意在防撞系统中强制使用ADS-B
summary: Provisions related to possible ADS-B In requirements for military aircraft remain unsettled. US lawmakers have agreed to legislation that would require civilian aircraft to carry automatic dependent surveillance broadcast (ADS-B) In systems, saying such a mand
summary_zh: 与军用飞机可能的 ADS-B In 要求相关的规定仍未确定。美国立法者已同意立法，要求
body_en: Provisions related to possible ADS-B In requirements for military aircraft remain unsettled.

US lawmakers have agreed to legislation that would require civilian aircraft to carry automatic dependent surveillance broadcast (ADS-B) In systems, saying such a mandate might become law by year-end.
The agreement, disclosed on 17 November by Senators Ted Cruz and Maria Cantwell, does not cover provisions for military aircraft, though negotiations are ongoing.

Still, the deal could mark the end of a stalemate that for more than a year has kept the US Congress from mandating traffic-avoidance technology that investigators say might have prevented a deadly January 2025 midair collision.

“The Senate and House have at long last reached an agreement in principle to mandate ADS-B In for all flights that are required to broadcast ADS-B Out,” says Cruz, chair of the Senate transportation committee.
“We still have a couple of details to negotiate,” he adds. “I believe we will pass this into law by the end of this year.”
Cantwell, the committee’s top Democrat, confirms that senators reached an ADS-B In “breakthrough” with Sam Graves, chair of the House of Representatives’ transportation committee.
The agreement also covers “helicopter route operations” and “fees”, Cantwell says without elaborating.

“While we have a deal in principle on the civil provisions, we do not have an agreement on the military provisions,” Cantwell adds. “We must have strong military accountability in the national airspace.”
The agreement’s details are not immediately available and lawmakers did not respond to requests for information.

The US Federal Aviation Administration since 2020 has required that most aircraft have ADS-B Out – a system that transmits an aircraft’s position, speed, altitude and other data. That information is used by air traffic controllers. Military aircraft operating missions deemed “sensitive” are exempt .
ADS-B Out data can also be received by other aircraft – but only those carrying the related ADS-B In. Pilots of aircraft with ADS-B In can see the location of traffic on cockpit displays.
The FAA does not require ADS-B In, though the US National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) has since 2008 recommended it do so.

Such a mandate gained momentum after a US Army Sikorsky UH-60L Black Hawk collided with a PSA Airlines regional jet in January 2025 near Ronald Reagan Washington National airport, killing all 67 people on both aircraft.
The NTSB said the accident may have been avoided if the aircraft had ADS-B In.
Since then, Congress has been wrangling over such a requirement, with House and Senate lawmakers proposing duelling bills.

The measures failed to pass amid technical disagreements and pushback. Trade group Aircraft Owners and Pilots Association, for instance, has urged that airports be prohibited from using ADS-B data to track aircraft for the purpose of levying landing fees.
The post US lawmakers agree to mandate ADS-B In collision-avoidance system first appeared on FlightGlobal .
body_zh: 与军用飞机可能的 ADS-B In 要求相关的规定仍未确定。
美国立法者已同意立法要求民用飞机携带自动相关监视广播（ADS-B）系统，并表示此类授权可能会在年底成为法律。
参议员特德·克鲁兹 (Ted Cruz) 和玛丽亚·坎特威尔 (Maria Cantwell) 于 11 月 17 日披露的该协议不包括军用飞机的条款，但谈判仍在进行中。
尽管如此，这项协议可能标志着僵局的结束，这一僵局一年多来一直阻碍美国国会强制实施交通避让技术，调查人员表示，这项技术可能避免了 2025 年 1 月发生的致命空中相撞事故。
参议院交通委员会主席克鲁兹表示：“参议院和众议院终于原则上达成一致，要求所有需要广播 ADS-B Out 的航班强制执行 ADS-B In。”
“我们还有一些细节需要协商，”他补充道。 “我相信我们将在今年年底前将其纳入法律。”
该委员会的民主党领袖坎特威尔证实，参议员们与众议院交通委员会主席萨姆·格雷夫斯在 ADS-B 方面取得了“突破”。
坎特韦尔表示，该协议还涵盖“直升机航线运营”和“费用”，但没有详细说明。
“虽然我们原则上就民事条款达成协议，但我们没有就军事条款达成协议，”坎特韦尔补充道。 “我们必须在国家领空实行强有力的军事问责制。”
该协议的细节尚未立即公布，立法者也没有回应信息请求。
美国联邦航空管理局自 2020 年起要求大多数飞机配备 ADS-B Out，这是一种传输飞机位置、速度、高度和其他数据的系统。该信息由空中交通管制员使用。执行被视为“敏感”任务的军用飞机除外。
ADS-B Out 数据也可以被其他飞机接收，但仅限于那些携带相关 ADS-B In 的飞机。配备 ADS-B In 的飞机飞行员可以在驾驶舱显示屏上看到交通位置。
尽管美国国家运输安全委员会 (NTSB) 自 2008 年以来一直建议这样做，但 FAA 并不要求采用 ADS-B。
2025 年 1 月，美国陆军西科斯基 UH-60L 黑鹰飞机在罗纳德·里根华盛顿国家机场附近与 PSA 航空公司的一架支线飞机相撞，导致两架飞机上的 67 人全部遇难，此后这一授权得到了推动。
NTSB 表示，如果飞机安装了 ADS-B，事故本来可以避免。
从那时起，国会一直在就这一要求争论不休，众议院和参议院议员提出了相互对立的法案。
由于技术分歧和阻力，这些措施未能通过。例如，贸易组织飞机所有者和飞行员协会敦促禁止机场使用 ADS-B 数据来跟踪飞机以征收着陆费。
美国立法者同意在防撞系统中强制使用 ADS-B 的帖子首先出现在 FlightGlobal 上。

title_en: GE Aerospace backs Dowty with $25 million innovation centre investment
title_zh: GE航空航天公司向Dowty投资2500万美元创新中心
summary: Propeller maker’s expertise is seen as crucial for development of open-fan engine. Propeller specialist Dowty is to open a new innovation centre in the UK, supported by a £19 million ($25 million) investment from parent company GE Aerospace. The centre will ex
summary_zh: 螺旋桨制造商的专业知识被认为对于开式风扇发动机的开发至关重要。螺旋桨专家 Dowty 将在该地区开设一个新的创新中心
body_en: Propeller maker’s expertise is seen as crucial for development of open-fan engine.
Propeller specialist Dowty is to open a new innovation centre in the UK, supported by a £19 million ($25 million) investment from parent company GE Aerospace.

The centre will expand capacity for the development and pre-production of next-generation propellers and other systems, including technologies in support of the open-fan engine being pursued by GE through its CFM International joint venture with Safran Aircraft Engines.

Announcing the move at the Aerospace Technology Institute conference in Newport, South Wales on 17 November, Alex Simpson, executive director of the RISE programme at GE Aerospace, said it was “a real investment in technology maturation, and a real investment in how we scale technology for the next generation [of engines].”
Part of the new facility’s remit is to work on ways of industrialising fan blade technologies to support the volumes required by a next-generation narrowbody programme.
Dowty, based in Gloucester in southwest England, has not revealed when it hopes to open the new centre.
FlightGlobal understands that although the company has yet to finalise the location for the facility, it is unlikely to be on the current site.
“This innovation centre is a tremendous opportunity for our people and our customers,” says Henry Johnston, Dowty chief executive.
“It will bring engineering talent and advanced capabilities together under one roof, so our teams can work together to rapidly develop and test next-generation technologies.”
Earlier this year, GE highlighted the growing involvement of Dowty in the CFM RISE open-fan technology demonstrator programme.

It cited the propeller maker’s design and industrial know-how as crucial to the effort, particularly in relation to the development of the variable pitch blades on the RISE engine’s 4m (13ft)-diameter fan.

However, Safran Aircraft Engines, which is responsible for the low-pressure system, including the composite fan, on the current-generation CFM Leap engine, has already produced a fan for the RISE demonstrator which will be tested in the coming months at its Villaroche facility near Paris.

Nonetheless, no decision has been taken yet on which of the CFM partner companies would build the fan blades if the RISE open-fan design moves from a demonstrator to a full-scale development programme.
The post GE Aerospace backs Dowty with $25 million innovation centre investment first appeared on FlightGlobal .
body_zh: 螺旋桨制造商的专业知识被认为对于开式风扇发动机的开发至关重要。
螺旋桨专家 Dowty 将在英国开设一个新的创新中心，母公司 GE Aerospace 投资 1900 万英镑（2500 万美元）。
该中心将扩大下一代螺旋桨和其他系统的开发和预生产能力，包括支持通用电气通过其与赛峰飞机发动机公司的 CFM 国际合资企业开发的开式风扇发动机的技术。
GE航空航天公司RISE项目执行董事亚历克斯·辛普森(Alex Simpson)于11月17日在南威尔士纽波特举行的航空航天技术研究所会议上宣布了这一举措，他表示，这是“对技术成熟度的真正投资，也是对我们如何扩展下一代[发动机]技术的真正投资。”
新工厂的部分职责是研究风扇叶片技术的工业化方法，以支持下一代窄体飞机计划所需的产量。
总部位于英格兰西南部格洛斯特的道蒂尚未透露何时开设新中心。
FlightGlobal 了解到，尽管该公司尚未最终确定该设施的位置，但不太可能位于当前地点。
Dowty 首席执行官亨利·约翰斯顿 (Henry Johnston) 表示：“这个创新中心对于我们的员工和客户来说是一个巨大的机会。”
“它将把工程人才和先进能力聚集在一个屋檐下，这样我们的团队就可以共同努力快速开发和测试下一代技术。”
今年早些时候，GE 强调了 Dowty 越来越多地参与 CFM RISE 开放式风扇技术演示计划。
该公司表示，螺旋桨制造商的设计和工业专业知识对于这项工作至关重要，特别是与 RISE 发动机直径 4m（13 英尺）风扇上的可变螺距叶片的开发相关。
然而，负责当前一代 CFM Leap 发动机上的低压系统（包括复合材料风扇）的赛峰飞机发动机公司已经为 RISE 演示机生产了一个风扇，该风扇将在未来几个月在巴黎附近的维拉罗什工厂进行测试。
尽管如此，如果 RISE 开放式风扇设计从演示转向全面开发计划，目前尚未决定由哪家 CFM 合作伙伴公司来制造风扇叶片。
GE航空航天公司向Dowty提供2500万美元创新中心投资后的消息首次出现在FlightGlobal上。

title_en: US transportation chief brings $50bn ATC request to lawmakers
title_zh: 美国交通运输部长向立法者提出 500 亿美元 ATC 请求
summary: Top US transportation official says last week’s ATC failure highlights need for prompt congressional approval. US transportation secretary Sean Duffy is calling on the US Congress to approve $50.1 billion in funding to modernise air traffic control (ATC) and s
summary_zh: 美国高级交通官员表示，上周的空中交通管制失败凸显了国会迅速批准的必要性。美国交通部长肖恩·达菲
body_en: Top US transportation official says last week’s ATC failure highlights need for prompt congressional approval.

US transportation secretary Sean Duffy is calling on the US Congress to approve $50.1 billion in funding to modernise air traffic control (ATC) and some airport infrastructure, insisting the 13 November system meltdown highlights the need for swift action.

Duffy and Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) chief Bryan Bedford requested the money in a 17 November letter to top US Senate and House of Representatives lawmakers. Duffy also made his case in meetings with Senators the same day.

“The urgent need for this investment became undeniable when outdated, legacy equipment disrupted aircraft communications and radar feeds – forcing the FAA to initiate a nationwide ground stop,” says the letter. “The administration urges Congress to provide $50.1 billion to deliver a truly world-class air traffic control network.”

Duffy, who has been pushing ATC modernisation since early 2025, previously said he needed $30 billion for the job but upped the figure to $50.1 billion on 13 November, hours after the FAA issued a ground stop due to a communications system failure. The ground stop lasted about 4h and upended US air travel, prompting airlines to cancel thousands of flights.

Duffy has said his earlier $30 billion estimate would cover ATC systems. Now he says more needs to be done. He is calling for a “full rebuild” that also includes improvements to infrastructure like runways and control towers.
“There’s a whole bunch of other work that has to happen. Towers are very expensive. It’s not a cheap proposition,” he says.
Duffy’s 17 November letter to Congress breaks down the $50.1 billion. It includes
$10.1bn for ATC modernisations, including a new automation platform, controller workstations, cloud computing, telecommunications and flight-flow management technologies, and facilities consolidation
$10bn for airport infrastructure improvements
$10bn to replace ATC terminals at large hub airports
$10bn to build up to five new Air Route Traffic Control Centres
Duffy and Bedford sent the letter to the chairs of the Senate and House appropriations committees.

President Donald Trump has made clear he supports Duffy’s request, posting to Truth Social on 15 November, “If Congress approves the desperately needed money for air traffic control, we can get it built quickly and efficiently. It will be the best system anywhere in the world.”
Some Democrats have already criticised Duffy’s request and questioned his ability to manage such a project.
Duffy has a better shot now at convincing lawmakers to approve the package than he will after the House and Senate shift from Republican to Democratic control in January.
Speaking on 17 November, Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer said he “has little faith” in Duffy’s plan, adding, “We have not been given the answers”.

The 13 November failure occurred as contractor L3Harris was replacing copper wires with fibre-optic wires, and as a new router was installed. That router started “flooding other routers” by making “1,000 connection attempts every four or five seconds”, causing ATC radar and air-to-ground communications failures at 17 of 22 FAA Air Route Traffic Control sites, Duffy said.
L3Harris says it is working with the FAA to understand the failure.
Story updated on 17 November to include comments from Schumer and to note Duffy met directly with lawmakers.
body_zh: 美国高级交通官员表示，上周的空中交通管制失败凸显了国会迅速批准的必要性。
美国交通部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 呼吁美国国会批准 501 亿美元的资金，用于现代化空中交通管制 (ATC) 和一些机场基础设施，并坚称 11 月 13 日的系统崩溃凸显了迅速采取行动的必要性。
达菲和美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 局长布莱恩·贝德福德 (Bryan Bedford) 在 11 月 17 日致美国参议院和众议院议员的一封信中请求提供这笔资金。达菲也在当天与参议员的会议上阐述了自己的观点。
信中说：“当过时的遗留设备扰乱飞机通信和雷达馈送时，对这项投资的迫切需求变得不可否认，迫使美国联邦航空管理局在全国范围内启动地面停止。” “政府敦促国会提供 501 亿美元，以建设真正世界一流的空中交通管制网络。”
达菲自 2025 年初以来一直在推动 ATC 现代化，此前曾表示，他需要 300 亿美元来完成这项工作，但在 11 月 13 日，即 FAA 因通信系统故障而发出地面停飞的几个小时后，他将这一数字提高到了 501 亿美元。地面停留持续了大约 4 个小时，扰乱了美国的航空旅行，促使航空公司取消了数千个航班。
达菲表示，他之前预计 300 亿美元将用于 ATC 系统。现在他说还需要做更多的事情。他呼吁进行“全面重建”，其中还包括改进跑道和控制塔等基础设施。
“还有一大堆其他工作要做。塔楼非常昂贵。这不是一个便宜的提议，”他说。
达菲 11 月 17 日致国会的信中详细列出了 501 亿美元。它包括
101 亿美元用于 ATC 现代化，包括新的自动化平台、控制器工作站、云计算、电信和飞行流量管理技术以及设施整合
100 亿美元用于改善机场基础设施
100 亿美元用于更换大型枢纽机场的 ATC 航站楼
耗资 100 亿美元建造最多五个新的空中航线交通控制中心
达菲和贝德福德将这封信寄给了参议院和众议院拨款委员会的主席。
唐纳德·特朗普总统明确表示支持达菲的请求，并于 11 月 15 日在 Truth Social 上发帖称，“如果国会批准空中交通管制急需的资金，我们就可以快速高效地建设它。这将是世界上最好的系统。”
一些民主党人已经批评了达菲的要求，并质疑他管理这样一个项目的能力。
与一月份参众两院从共和党控制权转向民主党控制权后相比，达菲现在更有机会说服立法者批准该计划。
11 月 17 日，参议院民主党领袖查克·舒默 (Chuck Schumer) 表示，他对达菲的计划“没有什么信心”，并补充道，“我们还没有得到答案”。
11 月 13 日发生故障时，承包商 L3Harris 正在用光纤线替换铜线，并安装了新路由器。达菲说，该路由器开始“每四到五秒进行 1,000 次连接尝试”，从而“淹没其他路由器”，导致 22 个 FAA 空中航线交通管制站点中的 17 个出现 ATC 雷达和空对地通信故障。
L3Harris 表示正在与 FAA 合作了解故障情况。
故事于 11 月 17 日更新，纳入了舒默的评论，并指出达菲直接会见了立法者。

title_en: Pratt & Whitney Canada partners with Ottawa start-up Dominion Dynamics on Arctic-focused autonomous fighter
title_zh: 普惠加拿大公司与渥太华初创公司 Dominion Dynamics 合作开发专注于北极的自主战斗机
summary: The Dominion Scout will be built around the PW300-series engine with extreme cold and long-range operations in mind. Engine manufacturer Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) is collaborating with Canadian defence start-up Dominion Dynamics to develop a new autonomous
summary_zh: Dominion Scout 将围绕 PW300 系列发动机建造，并考虑到极冷和远程操作。发动机制造商普惠公司
body_en: The Dominion Scout will be built around the PW300-series engine with extreme cold and long-range operations in mind.
Engine manufacturer Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) is collaborating with Canadian defence start-up Dominion Dynamics to develop a new autonomous tactical aircraft called the Scout.

Ottawa-based Dominion on 17 November confirmed the partnership, saying the Scout will be powered by P&WC’s PW300 series engine, with a focus on long-range operations in extreme cold environments with limited ground infrastructure.

Dominion says the Scout is intended to operate alongside crewed fighters, receiving tasking from both airborne and ground-based command systems. Previous renderings of the Scout concept show a tailless, blended-wing body with a ‘cranked kite’ outer mould shape and two recessed engines with air intakes positioned on the dorsal fuselage.

“We are building an aircraft designed to meet the unique demands of the Canadian Arctic, with aspirations to serve allies facing similar challenges,” says Eliot Pence, founder and chief executive of Dominion. “Keeping this work in Canada will not only strengthen our defence capability but also create and sustain skilled jobs through a new generation of aircraft.”

“Working with Dominion early in Scout’s development allows us to integrate our engine expertise into the aircraft’s design,” P&WC says. “By leveraging a commercial off-the-shelf solution, we can deliver an innovative product more efficiently.”

The government of Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has championed the development of a more robust domestic defence industry, amid a broader push to lessen Canada’s economic and military reliance on the United States. That push comes as Ottawa has embarked on a generational modernisation of the Royal Canadian Air Force that includes new fleets of training aircraft, tactical helicopters, long-range patrol aircraft and a new frontline multirole fighter jet.

Industry minister Melanie Joly is praising the collaborative effort between Dominion and P&WC, saying it “demonstrates the strength of Canada’s aerospace sector and the extraordinary expertise we have”.

“Canada’s economic sovereignty and security depend on our ability to build the technologies and capabilities we need here at home,” Joly says. “By strengthening domestic supply chains, creating good skilled jobs and building Canadian-made solutions for Canada and our allies, we are making our economy more resilient while positioning Canada to lead in the next generation of aerospace manufacturing.”

Dominion’s Scout is the first Canadian offering in the increasingly crowded field of uncrewed autonomous fighter aircraft, which are meant to supplement traditional tactical fighters with extra firepower and sensing capabilities, and to be available in significantly greater numbers.

The US Air Force is leading that revolution, with two such aircraft already in flight testing and under contract – the General Atomics FQ-42 and Anduril Industries FQ-44. Also flying in the US are Northrop Grumman’s YFQ-48 and the Kratos XQ-58, the latter being under contract with the US Marine Corps.
Australia is also a global leader in the space, with the MQ-28 Ghost Bat, designed and built by Boeing’s Australian subsidiary for the Royal Australian Air Force.
Europe is considerably farther behind, with a number of concept vehicles in development but not yet flying. Turkey’s Baykar has an advanced product, the Kizilelma, already flying.
The policy pivot toward prioritising domestic industry has thrown Canada’s agreement to acquire the Lockheed Martin F-35A stealth fighter into uncertainty.
Should Ottawa ultimately field the Scout, it would fly alongside the new fighter fleet planned for the RCAF.
The composition of that fleet remains an open question. Canada originally planned to field 88 Lockheed Martin F-35As, the first two of which were handed over to the RCAF in October.

Although Canadian officials confirm they are on firm contract for 12 F-35As, the government has backpedalled on committing to the full order. Carney has cited geopolitical disagreements with Washington, where US President Donald Trump has lashed out at Canada with trade sanctions, as the reason for rethinking the F-35 deal.

Sensing an opening, Lockheed competitor Saab stepped in with an offer to partner with several Canadian companies to build a fighter aircraft production line in Canada if Ottawa opts to buy Saab’s Gripen E/F fighter instead of more F-35As.

Industry minister Joly confirmed in October that the decision rests with Carney , who has remained tight-lipped on the matter. Joly did, however, hint that a resolution may be reached in the coming weeks.
A Canadian defence official who spoke to FlightGlobal under Chatham House rules in Munich this month said the RCAF is on a “knife-edge timeline to transition from a rapidly decaying CF-18 fleet”.
body_zh: Dominion Scout 将围绕 PW300 系列发动机建造，并考虑到极冷和远程操作。
发动机制造商普惠加拿大公司 (P&WC) 正在与加拿大国防初创公司 Dominion Dynamics 合作开发一种名为 Scout 的新型自主战术飞机。
总部位于渥太华的 Dominion 于 11 月 17 日确认了这一合作伙伴关系，称 Scout 将由普惠惠的 PW300 系列发动机提供动力，重点是在地面基础设施有限的极端寒冷环境中进行远程操作。
多米尼恩公司表示，侦察机旨在与载人战斗机一起作战，接收来自机载和地面指挥系统的任务。之前的Scout概念渲染图显示了一个无尾、混合翼机身，具有“曲柄风筝”外模形状和两个嵌入式发动机，进气口位于机身背部。
Dominion 创始人兼首席执行官艾略特·彭斯 (Eliot Pence) 表示：“我们正在建造一款飞机，旨在满足加拿大北极地区的独特需求，并希望为面临类似挑战的盟友提供服务。” “将这项工作留在加拿大不仅可以增强我们的国防能力，还可以通过新一代飞机创造和维持技术工作岗位。”
“在 Scout 开发初期与 Dominion 合作，使我们能够将我们的发动机专业知识融入到飞机的设计中，”P&WC 表示。 “通过利用商业现成的解决方案，我们可以更有效地提供创新产品。”
加拿大总理马克·卡尼领导的政府倡导发展更强大的国内国防工业，并更广泛地推动减少加拿大对美国的经济和军事依赖。这一推动之际，渥太华已开始对加拿大皇家空军进行代际现代化，其中包括新的教练机、战术直升机、远程巡逻机和新型前线多用途战斗机。
工业部长 Melanie Joly 赞扬 Dominion 和普惠惠之间的合作，称其“展示了加拿大航空航天业的实力和我们拥有的非凡专业知识”。
“加拿大的经济主权和安全取决于我们在国内建设所需技术和能力的能力，”乔利说。 “通过加强国内供应链、创造良好的技术就业机会以及为加拿大和我们的盟友打造加拿大制造的解决方案，我们正在使我们的经济更具弹性，同时使加拿大在下一代航空航天制造业中处于领先地位。”
Dominion 的 Scout 是加拿大在日益拥挤的无人自主战斗机领域推出的第一款产品，旨在为传统战术战斗机提供额外的火力和传感能力，并且数量显着增加。
美国空军正在引领这场革命，两架此类飞机已经在飞行测试中并已签订合同——通用原子公司的 FQ-42 和安杜里尔工业公司的 FQ-44。同样在美国飞行的还有诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的 YFQ-48 和奎托斯 XQ-58，后者与美国海军陆战队签订了合同。
澳大利亚也是该领域的全球领导者，其 MQ-28 Ghost Bat 是由波音公司澳大利亚子公司为澳大利亚皇家空军设计和制造的。
欧洲远远落后，有许多概念车正在开发中，但尚未飞行。土耳其Baykar公司的先进产品Kizilelma已经投入使用。
优先考虑国内工业的政策重心使加拿大是否同意购买洛克希德·马丁公司的 F-35A 隐形战斗机陷入不确定性。
如果渥太华最终部署侦察机，它将与加拿大皇家空军计划的新战斗机机队一起飞行。
该舰队的组成仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。加拿大原计划部署 88 架洛克希德·马丁公司 F-35A，其中前两架已于 10 月移交给加拿大皇家空军。
尽管加拿大官员确认他们已签订 12 架 F-35A 的确定合同，但政府在承诺全额订单方面却退缩了。卡尼将与华盛顿的地缘政治分歧作为重新考虑 F-35 交易的原因，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对加拿大实施了贸易制裁。
洛克希德公司的竞争对手萨博公司察觉到了一个机会，并提出如果渥太华选择购买萨博公司的“鹰狮”E/F战斗机而不是更多的F-35A，他们将与几家加拿大公司合作，在加拿大建造一条战斗机生产线。
工业部长乔利十月份证实，决定权在卡尼手中，但他对此事一直守口如瓶。然而，乔利确实暗示可能会在未来几周内达成解决方案。
本月，一位根据查塔姆研究所规则在慕尼黑接受 FlightGlobal 采访的加拿大国防官员表示，加拿大皇家空军正处于“从快速衰退的 CF-18 机队转型的关键时刻”。

title_en: Arab airlines remain resolute as they look to role beyond current crisis
title_zh: 阿拉伯航空公司依然坚定，希望在当前危机之后发挥作用
summary: Members of airline body the Arab Air Carriers’ Organization met for their annual meeting against a backdrop of volatility and disruption which has hit their traffic and financial performance progress this year. While Arab air carriers continue to count the cos
summary_zh: 阿拉伯航空公司组织的航空公司成员在动荡和混乱的背景下召开了年度会议
body_en: Members of airline body the Arab Air Carriers’ Organization met for their annual meeting against a backdrop of volatility and disruption which has hit their traffic and financial performance progress this year.

While Arab air carriers continue to count the cost of the conflict which erupted earlier this year, leaders in the region are taking hope from the resilience airlines have shown both historically and during the crisis.

Executives from operators in the region met in Doha in early November for this year’s Arab Air Carriers’ Organization (AACO) AGM, against a backdrop of heightened volatility in the region following the outbreak of the Iran conflict at the end of February. While the disruption to key Middle East markets and impact on the oil price has hit the whole airline industry, the most directly affected carriers have been those in the Middle East.

“We began 2026 with strong momentum following a very strong performance in 2025. Unfortunately, that momentum did not continue,” said AACO secretary general Abdul Wahab Teffaha, speaking in his opening address on 3 November.
Arab carriers had reported a strong 2025, generating operating margins of almost 11.8% – above the industry average of 7.2% – on passenger demand up 7%.

That, however, will change this year. While Teffaha says global passenger growth is expected to slow to about 2%, he expects Arab carriers to see passenger demand fall by around 10%, passenger load factor to slip to 77% and cargo traffic to drop 5%.
“Operating results have also shifted from a strong surplus in 2025 to an estimated operating margin of -2.7% in 2026,” he says. “These are difficult figures.”

Those challenges were further underlined when Emirates Airline disclosed a two-thirds slump in pre-tax and net profit for the six months ending September as the Dubai-based carrier was squeezed by regional conflict.

Teffaha, though, points to the resilience the region has shown in the past – in growing its market share from 2% back in 1980 to 10% before the crisis – and argues the current challenges should be put in perspective.
“It is indeed an exceptionally difficult year, but it will not change the historical course of this industry,” he says.
“The difficulties we face today do not diminish my confidence in this industry’s ability to overcome them and return to growth, as it has done after previous crises.”

Arab carriers particularly suffered from airspace closures and damage to infrastructure in the initial weeks after the US and Israeli air attacks on Iran and the latter’s retaliatory strikes in the region.

More recently there have been fatal strikes on key airports in Saudi Arabia, attributed to Houthi rebels. This forced Riyadh Air last month to temporarily move its operations from Riyadh to Saudi Arabia’s Al Qassim airport.

AACO members passed a resolution during their AGM condemning all attacks on civil aviation in the region, stressing “civil aviation must not be used as a means of pressure, intimidation or pursuit of military or political objectives”.
Speaking during a wide-ranging panel debate during the event, Arab carrier leaders detailed the direct impact the crisis has had on their operations.
Gulf Air was among those heavily impacted by the Iran conflict earlier this year, with the closure of Bahrain airspace for 40 days.

“We lost our airspace where we had all our aircraft,” says Gulf Air chief executive Martin Gauss, noting the airline effectively shifted operations across the border to Dammam in neighbouring Saudi Arabia, keeping connectivity to Bahrain open via the road bridge connecting the two states.
Gauss says this underlines the importance of the role Gulf Air plays for Bahrain.

“In the US if one airline shuts down, another takes over [at an airport]. But if you do not have somebody else that is interested to serve that place, you have to have your airline,” he says. “Nobody would have come and done the job that we have done while we were flying out of Dammam. We transported thousands of passengers who wanted to come to Bahrain while it was not accessible.”
Despite the expense of moving the operation to another base, he says the upside for the country “is much higher than the cost” of doing so.
body_zh: 阿拉伯航空公司组织的航空公司成员在今年的运输量和财务业绩进展受到波动和干扰的背景下召开了年度会议。
尽管阿拉伯航空公司仍在计算今年早些时候爆发的冲突造成的损失，但该地区领导人却从航空公司在历史上和危机期间表现出的韧性中看到了希望。
在二月底伊朗冲突爆发后该地区波动加剧的背景下，该地区运营商的高管于 11 月初在多哈举行了今年的阿拉伯航空运输组织 (AACO) 年度股东大会。虽然中东主要市场的混乱和油价的影响影响了整个航空业，但受影响最直接的航空公司是中东的航空公司。
AACO 秘书长阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜·特法哈 (Abdul Wahab Teffaha) 在 11 月 3 日的开幕致辞中表示：“继 2025 年的强劲表现之后，我们以强劲的势头开启了 2026 年。不幸的是，这种势头并没有持续下去。”
阿拉伯航空公司报告称，2025 年业绩强劲，客运需求增长 7%，营业利润率接近 11.8%，高于 7.2% 的行业平均水平。
然而，这种情况今年将会改变。尽管特法哈表示全球客运增长预计将放缓至 2% 左右，但他预计阿拉伯航空公司的客运需求将下降 10% 左右，客座率将下滑至 77%，货运量将下降 5%。
他表示：“运营业绩也从 2025 年的强劲盈余转变为 2026 年的预计运营利润率 -2.7%。” “这些都是困难的数字。”
阿联酋航空披露，由于这家总部位于迪拜的航空公司受到地区冲突的挤压，截至 9 月份的六个月税前利润和净利润下降了三分之二，这些挑战进一步凸显。
不过，特法哈指出该地区过去表现出的韧性 — — 市场份额从 1980 年的 2% 增长到危机前的 10% — — 并认为应该正确看待当前的挑战。
“这确实是异常艰难的一年，但这不会改变这个行业的历史进程，”他说。
“我们今天面临的困难并没有削弱我对这个行业克服困难并恢复增长能力的信心，就像之前的危机之后一样。”
在美国和以色列对伊朗进行空袭以及后者对该地区进行报复性打击后的最初几周内，阿拉伯航空公司尤其遭受了空域关闭和基础设施损坏。
最近，沙特阿拉伯的主要机场发生了由胡塞叛乱分子发动的致命袭击。这迫使利雅得航空上个月暂时将其业务从利雅得转移到沙特阿拉伯的卡西姆机场。
AACO 成员在年度大会上通过了一项决议，谴责该地区所有针对民航的袭击，强调“民航不得被用作施压、恐吓或追求军事或政治目标的手段”。
在活动期间举行的一场广泛的小组辩论中，阿拉伯航空公司领导人详细介绍了这场危机对其运营产生的直接影响。
海湾航空是今年早些时候受伊朗冲突影响最严重的航空公司之一，巴林领空关闭了 40 天。
海湾航空首席执行官马丁·高斯表示：“我们失去了拥有所有飞机的空域。”他指出，该航空公司实际上将业务跨越边境转移到邻国沙特阿拉伯的达曼，并通过连接两国的公路桥梁保持与巴林的连通。
高斯表示，这凸显了海湾航空对巴林所发挥的作用的重要性。
“在美国，如果一家航空公司关闭，另一家航空公司就会接管（在机场）。但如果你没有其他人有兴趣为该地方提供服务，你就必须拥有自己的航空公司，”他说。 “没有人会来完成我们从达曼起飞时所做的工作。我们运送了数千名想要前往巴林的乘客，但巴林交通不便。”
他表示，尽管将行动转移到另一个基地的费用很高，但这样做对国家的好处“远远高于成本”。

title_en: Lufthansa makes new labour offer to pilots but union unimpressed
title_zh: 汉莎航空向飞行员提出新的劳工提议但工会不为所动
summary: German airline group is seeking to end a long-running dispute which led to strikes earlier this year. Lufthansa Group has submitted an offer to its pilots’ union aimed at resolving a labour dispute that resulted in damaging strike action earlier in 2026. But w
summary_zh: 德国航空集团正在寻求结束一场长期争端，这场争端导致了今年早些时候的罢工。汉莎航空集团已向其 pi 提交了报价
body_en: German airline group is seeking to end a long-running dispute which led to strikes earlier this year.
Lufthansa Group has submitted an offer to its pilots’ union aimed at resolving a labour dispute that resulted in damaging strike action earlier in 2026.

But while the carrier says its offer is based on the recommendations of two independently-appointed arbitrators, the Vereinigung Cockpit (VC) union sees it as a rejection of a mediated proposal that it says was put forward after seven months of talks.

Lufthansa says its offer includes a “temporary stabilisation of pay levels, adjustments to salary scales and measures to increase productivity”. While it is offering a “one-off payment” for pilots in 2027 and 2028, salary increases would not take effect until 2029.
On the thorny issue of pensions, the airline group says it is following arbitrators’ recommendations and proposing cost-neutral adjustments.

“These include additional options for the investment of pension assets, a revised distribution of pension contributions over the course of an employee’s career, and taking the higher statutory retirement age into account with traditional pension benefits,” says Lufthansa Group.
Pilots from Lufthansa CityLine, which was shut down in April , will be offered “concrete employment prospects” that will include the option of transferring to flagship German unit Lufthansa Airlines.
The offer also dangles the prospect of up to 1,000 new cockpit hires by the end of 2033 and up to 150 additional captain promotions a year.

“Drawing on their many years of experience, the arbitrators have outlined a balanced compromise that requires concessions from both sides. We are ready to take this path and, on this basis, have submitted a comprehensive offer to VC,” says Lufthansa Group executive board member Michael Niggemann.

“It combines long-term employment and career prospects for our pilots with measures to strengthen the competitiveness of Lufthansa Classic. What matters now is that, together with VC, we reach an understanding on this basis.”
Union wants Lufthansa to ‘reconsider’ position
However, the union has accused Lufthansa Group of “rejecting” a solution put forward by mediators and drafting its own offer.

“Instead, the employer now comes round the corner with their own proposal, as if there had not been seven months of talks,” says VC. “For us, the rule remains: if we are to make concessions, we at least need appropriate safeguards for jobs.”
The union says it will give Lufthansa until 23 November “to reconsider their position”, noting that “the ball is now in the employer’s court”.
In response to the union’s argument, Lufthansa emphasises the difference between arbitration and mediation.

“The purpose of the mediation was to support dialogue between the collective-bargaining parties and enable them to explore new ideas and approaches to potential solutions. However, developing a concrete recommendation for resolving the collective-bargaining dispute was not part of the mediation process,” Lufthansa tells FlightGlobal.

“This task was instead assigned to the two arbitrators independently appointed by the respective collective-bargaining parties. Unlike the mediator, the arbitrators were tasked with developing a proposal for resolving the dispute. The recommendations of the two arbitrators…therefore form the key basis for evaluating potential solutions.”
Industrial action by Lufthansa’s pilots and cabin crew earlier this year cost the group about €150 million ($165 million) in the second quarter, dragging the German unit back into the red .

Lufthansa Group has embarked on a turnaround programme for its mainline carrier, which group chief executive Carsten Spohr said in early November “remains our focus and also our top priority on the management agenda”.
Lufthansa Airlines was the only one of the group’s network carriers to see profits fall in the third quarter .
body_zh: 德国航空集团正在寻求结束一场长期争端，这场争端导致了今年早些时候的罢工。
汉莎航空集团已向其飞行员工会提交了一份提议，旨在解决导致 2026 年初破坏性罢工行动的劳资纠纷。
不过，尽管该航空公司表示其提议是基于两名独立任命的仲裁员的建议，但驾驶舱联盟 (VC) 工会认为，这是对经过七个月谈判后提出的调解提议的拒绝。
汉莎航空表示，其提议包括“暂时稳定工资水平、调整工资标准以及提高生产率的措施”。虽然它在 2027 年和 2028 年为飞行员提供“一次性付款”，但加薪要到 2029 年才会生效。
在棘手的养老金问题上，该航空集团表示正在遵循仲裁员的建议，并提出成本中性的调整。
汉莎航空集团表示：“其中包括养老金资产投资的额外选择、员工职业生涯中养老金缴款分配的修订以及将较高的法定退休年龄与传统养老金福利考虑在内。”
4 月份关闭的汉莎城市线 (Lufthansa CityLine) 的飞行员将获得“具体的就业前景”，其中包括转到德国旗舰子公司汉莎航空 (Lufthansa Airlines) 的选择。
该提议还预示着到 2033 年底将雇佣多达 1,000 名新驾驶舱人员，并每年额外晋升多达 150 名机长。
“仲裁员根据多年的经验，提出了一个平衡的妥协方案，需要双方都做出让步。我们准备走这条路，并在此基础上向 VC 提交了一份全面的报价，”汉莎航空集团执行董事会成员迈克尔·尼格曼 (Michael Niggemann) 表示。
“它将我们飞行员的长期就业和职业前景与增强汉莎经典的竞争力的措施结合起来。现在重要的是，我们与VC一起在此基础上达成了谅解。”
联盟希望汉莎航空“重新考虑”立场
然而，工会指责汉莎集团“拒绝”调解员提出的解决方案并起草自己的提议。
“相反，雇主现在提出了自己的提案，就好像没有经过七个月的谈判一样，”VC 说。 “对我们来说，规则仍然是：如果我们要做出让步，我们至少需要适当的就业保障。”
工会表示将要求汉莎航空在 11 月 23 日之前“重新考虑他们的立场”，并指出“球现在在雇主手中”。
针对工会的论点，汉莎航空强调了仲裁与调解之间的区别。
“调解的目的是支持集体谈判各方之间的对话，使他们能够探索新的想法和方法来实现潜在的解决方案。然而，制定解决集体谈判纠纷的具体建议并不是调解过程的一部分，”汉莎航空告诉 FlightGlobal。
“这项任务被分配给了由各自集体谈判方独立任命的两名仲裁员。与调解员不同，仲裁员的任务是制定解决争议的提案。因此，两名仲裁员的建议......因此构成了评估潜在解决方案的关键基础。”
今年早些时候，汉莎航空飞行员和机组人员采取的罢工行动使该集团在第二季度损失了约 1.5 亿欧元（1.65 亿美元），使这家德国子公司重新陷入亏损。
汉莎航空集团已启动其干线航空公司的扭亏为盈计划，集团首席执行官 Carsten Spohr 在 11 月初表示，“这仍然是我们的重点，也是我们管理议程上的首要任务”。
汉莎航空是该集团网络航空公司中唯一一家第三季度利润下降的航空公司。

title_en: 7 Years On: Airbus A321XLR Launch Customer Middle East Airlines Finally Gets Its 1st Jet
title_zh: 7 年后：空中客车 A321XLR 启动客户中东航空公司终于获得第一架喷气式飞机
summary: Despite ordering the aircraft in 2019 and other carriers flying the jet, Middle East Airlines has finally received its first A321XLR.
summary_zh: 尽管在 2019 年订购了这架飞机，并且其他航空公司也运营过该飞机，但中东航空终于收到了第一架 A321XLR。
body_en: Louis is a military historian and the staff writer for History of War magazine, a leading military history monthly. He also has an interest in private and commercial aviation.

The Airbus A321XLR's launch customer, Middle East Airlines, has finally received the first of five of the aircraft that it has ordered. This carrier was the first to order the A321XLR back in 2019. A combination of local political and economic crises, certification delays, and option deferrals have caused the delay.

The aircraft builds upon Middle East Airlines' current fleet of modern Airbus jets. It gives a longer-range alternative to the 11 Airbus A321neos that are currently in the airline's fleet, according to Planespotters.net .
The Plane Is The First Of An Order Of Five Jets

The initial order made by Middle East Airlines in 2019 was for four A321XLRs, which has since been upgraded to five jets. Airbus says that the aircraft will allow the carrier to complete longer narrowbody missions while delivering a 30% reduction in fuel burn.
According to Airbus, Middle East Airlines' A321XLRs will be configured in a two-class layout. The jet will feature 160 seats, with 22 people enjoying the luxury of lie-flat business class.

The remaining 138 passengers will be in economy class. The airline generally offers 31 to 32 inches (79–81 cm) of seat pitch and an 18 inches (46 cm) of seat width in economy class, although the exact economy and business class product that will be available on the aircraft is not yet known.

Just one Embraer jet prevents the fleet of 27 jets from being exclusively Airbus. The fleet features Airbus A320 family jets, with widebody capability provided by the Airbus A330. Meanwhile, a modest order for the A330-900neo means further modernization for the carrier's long-haul flying. Use the Simple Flying Flight Tracker to find out where these Airbus jets currently fly.

The table below shows the current Middle East Airlines fleet, making use of Planespotters.net data, showing how the A321XLR could fit into the carrier's operations. It excludes the A321XLR that has just arrived, along with one A330-900neo, which is believed to be undergoing testing in Toulouse
The airline wrote in a press release at the time of the original order

"The flag carrier of Lebanon has signed a firm order for four A321XLRs, making it the launch airline customer of Airbus' latest evolution of the winning A321neo family. The agreement takes Middle East Airlines’ cumulative single aisle orders with Airbus to 15 A321neo family aircraft, including 11 A321neos and 4 A321XLRs with deliveries starting in 2020. MEA will use the A321XLR to strengthen its network in Africa and Asia."
Middle East Airlines Is Looking Forwards Despite The Ongoing Regional Crisis

The ongoing geopolitical crisis in the Middle East is a clear reason that the A321XLR's arrival has been delayed. Yet, Middle East Airlines is also clearly trying to make the best of a bad situation. The carrier has kept flying throughout the conflict, Aviation Week reports, although with passenger numbers falling by over 50%. The airline was working to get these numbers back up to 70% during the summer.

Speaking with Aviation Week, Chairman and CEO Mohamad El-Hout said that it's all about flexibility and balanced growth. He said that long-term planning has been replaced with year-by-year thinking, aiming to respond to unpredictable conflicts and instability in the region and involving Lebanon.

Another issue that Middle East Airlines has been struggling with is problems with Pratt & Whitney geared turbofans, and it is thought the airline has dealt with groundings as a result. El-Hout hopes the fact that its A321XLRs will be fitted with the Advantage version of the GTF engines will mean the new aircraft don't face the problem. Despite all these internal and external challenges, the airline is currently working to launch FlyBeirut in 2027. This subsidiary will compete with Middle East Airlines' low-cost rivals.
body_zh: 路易斯是一位军事历史学家，也是领先的军事历史月刊《战争史》杂志的特约撰稿人。他还对私人和商业航空感兴趣。
空客 A321XLR 的首发客户中东航空公司终于收到了其订购的五架飞机中的第一架。该航空公司是 2019 年第一家订购 A321XLR 的航空公司。当地政治和经济危机、认证延迟和选件延期等综合因素导致了延误。
该飞机以中东航空公司现有的现代空中客车飞机机队为基础。据 Planespotters.net 报道，它为该航空公司机队目前拥有的 11 架空客 A321neo 提供了更远航程的替代方案。
这架飞机是五架喷气式飞机中的第一架
中东航空公司在 2019 年的最初订单是四架 A321XLR 飞机，此后已升级为五架喷气式飞机。空客表示，该飞机将使航空公司能够完成更长的窄体机任务，同时燃油消耗减少 30%。
据空客称，中东航空的A321XLR飞机将采用两舱布局。该飞机将设有 160 个座位，可容纳 22 人，享受平躺商务舱的奢华体验。
其余138名乘客将乘坐经济舱。该航空公司通常在经济舱提供 31 至 32 英寸（79-81 厘米）的座椅间距和 18 英寸（46 厘米）的座椅宽度，但飞机上提供的具体经济舱和商务舱产品尚不清楚。
仅凭一架巴西航空工业公司的喷气式飞机就足以让 27 架喷气式飞机组成的机队不再是空客的专属。该机队拥有空客 A320 系列喷气式飞机，并具有空客 A330 提供的宽体能力。与此同时，A330-900neo 的少量订单意味着该航空公司长途飞行的进一步现代化。使用简单飞行航班跟踪器了解这些空客飞机当前的飞行地点。
下表利用 Planespotters.net 数据显示了中东航空公司目前的机队，展示了 A321XLR 如何适应该航空公司的运营。其中不包括刚刚抵达的 A321XLR 以及一架据信正在图卢兹接受测试的 A330-900neo
该航空公司在原始订单时的一份新闻稿中写道
“黎巴嫩旗舰航空公司已签署了四架 A321XLR 的确定订单，使其成为空客最新获胜 A321neo 系列飞机的启动航空公司客户。该协议使中东航空与空客的累计单通道订单达到 15 架 A321neo 系列飞机，包括 11 架 A321neos 和 4 架 A321XLR，将于 2020 年开始交付。MEA 将使用 A321XLR加强其在非洲和亚洲的网络。”
尽管地区危机持续不断，中东航空公司仍展望未来
中东持续的地缘政治危机是 A321XLR 延迟到货的一个明显原因。然而，中东航空公司显然也在努力在糟糕的情况下尽力而为。据《航空周刊》报道，尽管乘客数量下降了 50% 以上，但该航空公司在整个冲突期间一直保持飞行。该航空公司正努力在夏季将这些数字恢复到 70%。
董事长兼首席执行官 Mohamad El-Hout 在接受《航空周刊》采访时表示，这一切都与灵活性和平衡增长有关。他说，长期规划已被逐年思考所取代，旨在应对该地区不可预测的冲突和不稳定，并涉及黎巴嫩。
中东航空公司一直在努力解决的另一个问题是普惠公司齿轮涡轮风扇发动机的问题，据信该航空公司已因此停飞。 El-Hout 希望其 A321XLR 将配备 Advantage 版本的 GTF 发动机，这意味着新飞机不会面临这个问题。尽管面临所有这些内部和外部挑战，该航空公司目前正在努力于 2027 年推出 FlyBeirut。该子公司将与中东航空公司的低成本竞争对手展开竞争。

title_en: How Much Do Captains & First Officers Earn At US Carriers In 2026?
title_zh: 2026 年美国航空公司的机长和副驾驶的收入是多少？
summary: Pilots still earn a huge amount, with experienced widebody captains enjoying the best compensation.
summary_zh: 飞行员的收入仍然很高，经验丰富的宽体机机长享受着最好的报酬。
body_en: Louis is a military historian and the staff writer for History of War magazine, a leading military history monthly. He also has an interest in private and commercial aviation.

Becoming a pilot remains one of the world's most lucrative professions. Salaries vary depending on many factors despite union standardization. These factors include whether the pilot is a first officer or a captain, the aircraft they fly (more seats usually means more money), years of service, and hours flown each month.

A United Airlines widebody captain makes $483.74 per hour after 12 years of service, Air Gazette reports. This is an end-of-career level of compensation. Early-career pilots are still well paid, with legacy airline captains making over $100 per hour.

There is a lot of similarity in the pay pilots can expect at legacy carriers at comparable points in their careers. Starting pay is highest at United, with first officers making $125.52 per hour on their first day, compared with Delta Air Lines' $118 and American Airlines' $113. This puts the annual salary at United for first-year first officers at $120,499 (assuming 80 flying hours a month), while the same pilot at Delta would make $113,280 and at American Airlines $108,480.

At each of these airlines, mid-career first officers (in their fifth year of service) will earn substantially more. The annual wage for a pilot flying 80 hours per month at United is approximately $227,405, higher than the $182,400 paid by Delta and $187,200 paid by American Airlines .
The table below uses data collected by Air Gazette to compare the annual salaries of a United pilot at various stages in their career, and flying widebody and narrowbody jets

Widebody captains with 12 years of service are the gold standard for these legacy airlines, earning enormous compensation. The hourly wage for such captains is $483.74 at United, $465.13 at Delta, and the same at American Airlines. This translates to about $464,390 for a United widebody captain who flies 80 hours a month, while similar Delta and American Airlines captains earn around $446,525.
Other Benefits Are Key Differentials Between The Legacy Carriers

Across each stage of their careers, as both a captain and a first officer, pilots earn roughly comparable amounts by working for the three legacy carriers. Other differentials then factor into which airline a pilot tries to work for. This includes 401(k) contributions, per diem allowances, and more. Delta offers profit sharing as an additional perk. Neither United nor American Airlines offer a significant equivalent.

The table below illustrates differences in other forms of compensation for each legacy carrier. The data is from Air Gazette and applies to a widebody captain with 12 years of service and flying 80 hours per month. It suggests that the additional benefits available at Delta could make it more desirable for pilots than at United, despite a lower base pay

Career progression opportunities matter more to many pilots early in their careers than maximizing earnings. For pilots, the main progression is from first officer to captain. Historically, a pilot had to wait 10 to 15 years for the upgrade, usually waiting for captains to retire ahead of them. Industry-wide retirements are running at over 5,000 a year, but Delta could have the best opportunities for first officers on the cusp of promotion. That is because the carrier has projected 506 mandatory retirements in 2026 alone.

Historically, regional airlines offered exceptionally low salaries . Pilots took a hit to career progression while they waited for an opportunity with one of the US' legacy carriers. The situation has now turned around, with regional carriers offering strong salaries from the very start of a pilot's career.

The wage increase was caused by a post-pandemic surge in demand that regional carriers couldn't keep up with. They had to raise their salaries to attract enough pilots. Pilots' union negotiations with legacy airlines in 2023 and 2024 also forced regional airlines to respond.

In 2026, first officers at regional airlines make $50 to $90 per hour, while captains make $100 to $150 per hour. This is still far lower than Delta, American Airlines, or United, but is enough to make a great living. The table below uses Rotate Pilot data to show the variation in first officer and captain pay per flying hour at some major regional airlines in the US. Career progression remains essential for pilots working in these sorts of airlines, so the ease of flow into a major airline is often more important than the wage earned
Envoy Air, PSA Airlines and Piedmont Airlines

As with the big three airlines, experienced captains earn substantially more than early-career first officers. American Flyers estimates regional captain salaries sit between $140,000 and $150,000. Experienced pilots at the best regional carriers can make substantially more. The salary for a captain at Endeavor Air in their 12th year of service is over $200,000. Make use of Simple Flying's Flight Tracker to better understand the kinds of routes these carriers operate.
Pay Isn't The Only Decision-Maker For US Pilots

As with any job, pay is just one of multiple factors influencing where a pilot might decide to work. In 2026, there are plenty of reasons to take the relative pay hit and work at a regional airline. The most obvious deciding factor beyond pilot salaries is the career progression that these pilots can access. This isn't only about transitioning to a major airline, as regional airlines offer experience that isn't readily accessible at United, Delta, or American Airlines. For example, these airlines often fly to remote locations where pilots learn to operate in adverse weather conditions and on challenging runways.

Career progression at regional carriers can also be faster even for those who don't want to work at Delta, United, or American Airlines. This is because first officers can progress much faster to the role of captain.

The newly found job security for regional pilots can also attract many professionals. The sector's enormous growth means unexpected redundancies are far less of a concern. This security means pilots can be more flexible with their career choices.
body_zh: 路易斯是一位军事历史学家，也是领先的军事历史月刊《战争史》杂志的特约撰稿人。他还对私人和商业航空感兴趣。
成为飞行员仍然是世界上最赚钱的职业之一。尽管工会标准化，但工资仍取决于许多因素。这些因素包括飞行员是副驾驶还是机长、他们驾驶的飞机（座位越多通常意味着更多的钱）、服务年限以及每月的飞行小时数。
据 Air Gazette 报道，美国联合航空公司一名宽体机机长在服务 12 年后每小时收入为 483.74 美元。这是职业生涯结束时的薪酬水平。职业生涯早期的飞行员的薪水仍然很高，传统航空公司的机长每小时收入超过 100 美元。
传统航空公司在职业生涯的可比阶段所期望的薪酬有很多相似之处。联合航空的起薪最高，副驾驶第一天每小时的工资为 125.52 美元，而达美航空为 118 美元，美国航空为 113 美元。这使得美联航第一年副驾驶的年薪为 120,499 美元（假设每月飞行 80 小时），而同一飞行员在达美航空的年薪为 113,280 美元，在美国航空的年薪为 108,480 美元。
在这些航空公司中，处于职业生涯中期的副机长（服务第五年）的收入将大幅增加。联合航空每月飞行 80 小时的飞行员的年薪约为 227,405 美元，高于达美航空支付的 182,400 美元和美国航空支付的 187,200 美元。
下表使用 Air Gazette 收集的数据来比较美联航飞行员在其职业生涯各个阶段以及驾驶宽体和窄体喷气式飞机的年薪
拥有 12 年服务经验的宽体机长是这些传统航空公司的黄金标准，可赚取巨额报酬。此类机长的时薪在联合航空为 483.74 美元，在达美航空为 465.13 美元，在美国航空也是如此。对于每月飞行 80 小时的美联航宽体机机长来说，这相当于约 464,399 美元，而类似的达美航空和美国航空机长的收入约为 446,525 美元。
其他优势是传统运营商之间的主要区别
在职业生涯的每个阶段，无论是作为机长还是副驾驶，飞行员通过为三大传统航空公司工作，赚取的收入大致相当。其他差异因素还包括飞行员试图为哪家航空公司工作。这包括 401(k) 供款、每日津贴等。达美航空提供利润分享作为额外福利。美国联合航空公司和美国航空公司都没有提供同等的服务。
下表说明了每个传统运营商在其他形式的补偿方面的差异。该数据来自 Air Gazette，适用于一名工龄 12 年、每月飞行 80 小时的宽体机机长。这表明，尽管基本工资较低，但达美航空提供的额外福利可能比美联航更受飞行员欢迎
对于许多职业生涯早期的飞行员来说，职业发展机会比收入最大化更重要。对于飞行员来说，主要的晋升是从副驾驶到机长。从历史上看，飞行员必须等待 10 到 15 年才能升级，通常要等待机长提前退休。全行业的退休人数每年超过 5,000 人，但达美航空可能为即将晋升的副驾驶提供最好的机会。这是因为该航空公司预计仅 2026 年就有 506 人强制退役。
从历史上看，支线航空公司提供的工资非常低。飞行员在等待美国一家传统航空公司的机会时，职业发展受到了打击。现在情况发生了转变，支线航空公司从飞行员职业生涯的一开始就提供了丰厚的薪水。
工资上涨是由于地区航空公司无法跟上大流行后需求激增造成的。他们必须提高工资才能吸引足够的飞行员。 2023 年和 2024 年飞行员与传统航空公司的工会谈判也迫使支线航空公司做出回应。
到 2026 年，支线航空公司的副驾驶每小时收入 50 至 90 美元，而机长每小时收入 100 至 150 美元。这仍然远低于达美航空、美国航空或联合航空，但足以过上美好的生活。下表使用轮换飞行员数据显示了美国一些主要支线航空公司的副驾驶和机长每飞行小时工资的变化。对于在此类航空公司工作的飞行员来说，职业发展仍然至关重要，因此进入大型航空公司的难易程度通常比赚取的工资更重要
特使航空、PSA 航空和皮埃蒙特航空
与三大航空公司一样，经验丰富的机长的收入远远高于职业生涯早期的副机长。美国飞行航空 (American Flyers) 估计支线机长的薪资在 14 万至 15 万美元之间。最好的区域性航空公司经验丰富的飞行员可以赚更多的钱。奋进航空机长在服役第 12 年的年薪超过 20 万美元。利用 Simple Flying 的航班跟踪器更好地了解这些航空公司运营的航线类型。
薪酬并不是美国飞行员的唯一决策者

与任何工作一样，薪酬只是影响飞行员决定工作地点的多个因素之一。到 2026 年，有很多理由接受相对工资下降并在支线航空公司工作。除了飞行员工资之外，最明显的决定因素是这些飞行员​​可以获得的职业发展。这不仅仅是过渡到大型航空公司的问题，因为支线航空公司提供的体验是联合航空、达美航空或美国航空所无法获得的。例如，这些航空公司经常飞往偏远地区，飞行员在那里学习如何在恶劣的天气条件和具有挑战性的跑道上操作。
即使对于那些不想在达美航空、联合航空或美国航空工作的人来说，支线航空公司的职业发展也会更快。这是因为副驾驶可以更快地晋升为机长。
新发现的区域试点工作保障也可以吸引许多专业人士。该行业的巨大增长意味着意外裁员远不那么令人担忧。这种安全性意味着飞行员可以更加灵活地选择职业。

title_en: American Airlines 737 Carrying US Senator Suffers Engine Failure, Diverts To Orlando
title_zh: 载有美国参议员的美国航空 737 飞机引擎故障，改飞奥兰多
summary: An American Airlines Boeing 737 carrying Senator Ashley Moody diverted to Orlando after pilots shut down an engine.
summary_zh: 一架载有参议员阿什利·穆迪的美国航空波音 737 飞机在飞行员关闭引擎后改道飞往奥兰多。
body_en: Paul has had a career of 25+ years focused on the international technology sector, which has taken him to over 100 countries. Along the way, he developed a deep love for aviation, with a travel bucket list measured by aircraft types flown rather than destinations reached. Now he brings that avgeek passion, along with the journalism experience he accumulated early in his career, to write insightful pieces for Simple Flying.

An American Airlines Boeing 737-800 carrying US Senator Ashley Moody made an emergency landing at Orlando International Airport (MCO) on Monday, November 16, after experiencing an engine problem shortly after takeoff. Flight AA496 was traveling from Tampa to Washington DC when its pilots declared a Mayday and shut down the aircraft's left engine. The aircraft landed safely, with the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) confirming that it has opened an investigation .

The incident involved 178 people aboard the aircraft, which was identified as a 2013-built Boeing 737-800 registered N924NN . Flight-tracking records indicate that the aircraft spent just 47 minutes in the air before diverting to Orlando, where the crew had requested a longer runway and access to American Airlines maintenance facilities. Moody subsequently traveled to Washington on another flight, but missed Monday evening's Senate votes.
American Airlines 737 Declares Mayday After Engine Problem

Flight AA496 departed Tampa International Airport (TPA) at approximately 1:57 PM Eastern Time. Aerocorner reports that while climbing through 9,300 feet, the crew reported abnormal indications involving the left CFM56 engine and requested permission to level off at 10,000 feet. The pilots began working through their checklists before deciding that the engine needed to be shut down. The aircraft was originally scheduled to complete the approximately 815 mile (1,312 km) journey to Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport (DCA).

Approximately three minutes after the initial report, the pilots declared an emergency and informed air traffic control that they were shutting down the left engine. According to ATC recordings reported by People , the crew requested vectors toward Orlando and one of its longer runways. The controller offered a return to Tampa instead, but the pilots maintained their preference for Orlando.

The aircraft remained at 9,700 feet for approximately 17 minutes while the pilots completed their procedures. It subsequently landed on Orlando's Runway 36L at approximately 2:44 PM. The cause of the engine malfunction has not yet been established.
Why Did The Pilots Choose Orlando Instead Of Tampa?

Although the flight had only recently departed Tampa, the crew selected Orlando as their diversion, which sits approximately 81 miles (130 km) east of their departure point. Two factors reportedly influenced the decision: Orlando's longer runways and American Airlines' own maintenance facilities there. The pilots specifically mentioned these advantages during their conversation with air traffic control, suggesting the diversion was driven by operational considerations rather than geographical proximity alone.

Orlando has four runways, including two exceeding 12,000 feet, whereas Tampa's longest measures 11,002 feet. Flight AA496 landed on Orlando's 12,004-foot Runway 36L, providing approximately 1,000 feet of additional runway compared with Tampa's longest. Longer runways can offer greater stopping-distance margins during an abnormal landing, although an engine shutdown does not automatically increase the required landing distance.

Another significant advantage was American's maintenance presence at Orlando. The airport's June 2026 airline services directory confirms that American performs its own line maintenance there, while it has to rely on third-party maintenance providers at Tampa. This would have been critical to the pilots, knowing that if American's own technicians could inspect and repair the aircraft directly, it is likely to return to the air sooner. The airline subsequently dispatched another Boeing 737-800, N917NN, which reached Washington at approximately 7:20 PM.
What Are The FAA Rules For An Engine Failure?

Under 14 CFR §121.565 , when an aircraft engine fails or is shut down to prevent possible damage, the pilot in command must land at the "nearest suitable airport" in terms of time. The regulation permits additional discretion for aircraft with three or more engines, but not twin-engine aircraft such as the Boeing 737-800. Consequently, continuing to Washington was not an option for the American Airlines crew once the engine was shut down.

The regulation does not define suitability solely by distance. Pilots must consider factors such as runway availability, aircraft performance, weather, terrain, and the ability to land safely. It also requires crews to report an in-flight engine shutdown and keep air traffic control informed until landing. Modern twin-engine airliners are designed to fly safely with one engine inoperative, allowing crews to complete checklists and prepare for a controlled landing, as occurred aboard AA496.

Moody is not the first US lawmaker to experience an aviation emergency in 2026. In May, Representative Tracey Mann was aboard an American Eagle regional jet that made an emergency landing in Kansas City after smoke was reported in the cabin. More recently, in September, a Coast Guard aircraft carrying Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin suffered an engine failure and landed safely at Washington Reagan National Airport. Moody, meanwhile, boarded the replacement flight to Washington but arrived after Senate voting had concluded.

body_zh: Paul 拥有超过 25 年的职业生涯，专注于国际技术领域，足迹遍及 100 多个国家。一路走来，他对航空产生了深深的热爱，他的旅行愿望清单是根据飞行的飞机类型而不是到达的目的地来衡量的。现在，他带着这种平均极客的热情，以及他在职业生涯早期积累的新闻经验，为《简单飞行》撰写了富有洞察力的文章。
11 月 16 日星期一，美国航空公司一架载有美国参议员阿什利·穆迪 (Ashley Moody) 的波音 737-800 飞机在起飞后不久遇到引擎问题，紧急降落在奥兰多国际机场 (MCO)。 AA496 航班当时正从坦帕飞往华盛顿特区，飞行员宣布求救并关闭了飞机的左侧发动机。飞机安全着陆，美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）确认已展开调查。
该事件涉及飞机上的 178 人，该飞机被确认为 2013 年制造的波音 737-800，注册号为 N924NN。飞行跟踪记录显示，这架飞机在空中仅飞行了 47 分钟，然后就转向奥兰多，机组人员要求延长跑道并使用美国航空的维修设施。穆迪随后乘坐另一趟航班前往华盛顿，但错过了周一晚上的参议院投票。
美国航空 737 因发动机问题宣布求救
AA496 航班于东部时间下午 1:57 左右从坦帕国际机场 (TPA) 起飞。 Aerocorner 报道称，在爬升 9,300 英尺高度时，机组人员报告左侧 CFM56 发动机出现异常迹象，并请求允许在 10,000 英尺高度改平。飞行员开始检查检查表，然后决定需要关闭发动机。该飞机原计划完成前往罗纳德·里根华盛顿国家机场 (DCA) 的约 815 英里（1,312 公里）的旅程。
初次报告后大约三分钟，飞行员宣布紧急情况，并通知空中交通管制部门，他们将关闭左侧发动机。根据《人物》杂志报道的空中交通管制记录，机组人员要求引导飞机前往奥兰多及其较长的跑道之一。管制员建议返回坦帕，但飞行员仍然选择飞往奥兰多。
当飞行员完成他们的程序时，飞机在 9,700 英尺的高度停留了大约 17 分钟。随后于下午 2:44 左右降落在奥兰多 36L 跑道上。发动机故障的原因尚未确定。
为什么飞行员选择奥兰多而不是坦帕？
尽管该航班最近才从坦帕起飞，但机组人员选择了奥兰多作为改道地点，该地点位于出发点以东约 81 英里（130 公里）处。据报道，有两个因素影响了这一决定：奥兰多更长的跑道和美国航空在那里的维护设施。飞行员在与空中交通管制人员交谈时特别提到了这些优势，表明改道是出于操作考虑，而不仅仅是地理上的接近。
奥兰多有 4 条跑道，其中两条超过 12,000 英尺，而坦帕最长的跑道长达 11,002 英尺。 AA496 航班降落在奥兰多 12,004 英尺长的 36L 跑道上，与坦帕最长的跑道相比，提供了约 1,000 英尺的额外跑道。尽管发动机关闭不会自动增加所需的着陆距离，但较长的跑道可以在非正常着陆期间提供更大的停止距离余量。
另一个显着优势是美国航空在奥兰多的维修设施。该机场 2026 年 6 月的航空公司服务目录证实，美国航空在那里进行自己的航线维护，但必须依赖坦帕的第三方维护提供商。这对飞行员来说至关重要，因为他们知道，如果美国自己的技术人员能够直接检查和修理飞机，它可能会更快地返回空中。该航空公司随后派出另一架波音 737-800 N917NN，于晚上 7:20 左右抵达华盛顿。
FAA 对于发动机故障有哪些规则？
根据 14 CFR §121.565 规定，当飞机发动机发生故障或关闭以防止可能的损坏时，机长必须按时间降落在“最近的合适机场”。该法规允许对三台或三台以上发动机的飞机给予额外的自由裁量权，但不适用于波音 737-800 等双引擎飞机。因此，一旦发动机关闭，美国航空机组人员就不再选择继续飞往华盛顿。
该法规并不仅仅通过距离来定义适用性。飞行员必须考虑跑道可用性、飞机性能、天气、地形和安全着陆能力等因素。它还要求机组人员报告飞行中发动机关闭的情况，并在着陆前随时通知空中交通管制。现代双引擎客机设计为在其中一个引擎不工作的情况下安全飞行，允许机组人员完成检查清单并为受控着陆做好准备，就像 AA496 上发生的那样。
穆迪并不是第一位在 2026 年经历航空紧急情况的美国议员。5 月，众议员特雷西·曼 (Tracey Mann) 乘坐的一架美国之鹰支线喷气式飞机在机舱内冒烟后紧急降落在堪萨斯城。最近，九月，一架载有国土安全部部长马克韦恩·穆林的海岸警卫队飞机发动机发生故障，安全降落在华盛顿里根国家机场。与此同时，穆迪登上了飞往华盛顿的替代航班，但在参议院投票结束后抵达。
