title_en: Ranked: Which Of United Airlines' US Hubs Run The Best Operation In 2026?
title_zh: 排名：2026 年联合航空的哪些美国枢纽运营状况最佳？
summary: Going down the list from perpetually behind schedule to persistently punctual.
summary_zh: 从永远落后于计划到持续准时。
body_en: Luke Diaz is a freelance military writer with experience with active duty experience in the US Navy as well as defense and industrial engineering. He is a former Naval Flight Officer who performed tactical air control on the carrier-based E-2 Hawkeye.

United Airlines operates the largest fleet of jetliners in the world, serving one of the world’s most expansive and complex networks of air routes. To keep domestic commuters and international flyers moving, UA contends with harsh weather, air traffic control failures, and other unexpected disruptions across roughly 4,500 daily departures at its top hubs. This countdown examines the hard data to reveal how airfields from the West Coast to the Windy City, Big Apple, Lone Star State, and even the nation's capital stack up.
Down from 73% in 2025 to 71% on-time in 2026, so far

According to Delay Atlas, Chicago O'Hare is at the very bottom for on-time performance (OTP). It is the network's worst-performing hub, with only 73% of United flights arriving as expected in 2025. Tight flight schedules and congested skies quickly collapse during summer thunderstorms in the Midwest. Meanwhile, winter snow and ice pose another seasonal weather obstacle. The airport as a whole ranks approximately 24th this year among major US airports.

Traveling in the morning normally goes smoothly, but as the day goes on, delays mount quickly. Last year, nearly 90% of flights departing between 5:00 AM and 8:00 AM did so on time. By the busy evening rush between 5:00 PM and 8:00 PM, on-time departures (OTD) dropped below 70%. Traffic jams on the tarmac often force arriving planes to sit on the ramp waiting for an open gate.

All that waiting on the ground creates big headaches for both the airline and passengers. A Boeing 737 sitting with its engines idling burns roughly 1,000 to 1,200 pounds (454 to 544 kg) of fuel every hour just waiting to move. Those delays can even cause pilots to time out of legal working hours and force a crew swap. In the worst-case scenario, travelers could be left stranded without their checked bags, making ORD the biggest drag on United's schedule.
Up from 76% in 2025 to 79% on-time so far this year

Last year, United canceled 2.3% of its Newark schedule, the highest cancellation percentage of any United hub, and just 76.3% of its flights landed on time. Despite the sound of slot restrictions, the airport's overall rise to fifth place in the country for punctuality was aided by federal regulations. The cap set a ceiling of 72 takeoffs and landings each hour, and yet UA still has trouble here, despite OTD rising to 79.0% in 2026.

Situated in one of the busiest air corridors in the nation, the airport only has a small footprint to operate out of. The confined airfield leaves almost no room for error. When bad weather hits the East Coast, air traffic slows to a crawl. That's when UA often has to cancel flights outright rather than let planes circle in the air. Major runway construction made things even tighter, temporarily cutting flights down to 28 per hour and forcing UA to trim its peak schedules to prevent gridlock on the apron.

To carry as many travelers as possible without breaking the strict FAA hourly flight cap, UA employs its biggest jets for domestic trips as well as overseas itineraries. The airline flies Boeing 777 widebodies, which weigh over 304,500 pounds (138,119 kg), between Newark and San Francisco. Using one giant twin-aisle instead of two smaller narrowbodies lets United move hundreds more people at once while saving precious takeoff spots and gate space.
Down from 79% in 2025 to 76% on-time so far this year

With almost 108,000 flights passing through its ramp in 2025, Denver claims the title as United's busiest hub. The airline reported a network-best cancellation rate of only 0.41% and a strong 78.9% on-time arrival (OTA) rate despite the heavy demand. Air traffic control can also land and launch a higher volume of jets than at airports like Newark without creating ground gridlock, thanks to Denver's generous real estate.

The airport is situated on expansive plains with six runways that never overlap, maximizing ground operations efficiency. Although the airport layout is ideal for dense schedules, Denver's high altitude presents a weather hurdle in summer. Sitting 5,434 feet (1,656 meters) above sea level, the air is already thinner than at coastal airports. On hot summer afternoons, that thin, warm air behaves as if it were over 9,000 feet (2,743 meters) high in a turbofan engine.

The low density and high temperature make it much harder for jet engines to pull in enough air to produce takeoff thrust. On a heavy Boeing 737 MAX , the engines have to spin at over 100% N1 and can push internal exhaust temperatures close to 1,832°F (1,000°C) just to get off the ground. That burns more gas on every sortie and compounds wear and tear on the planes.
Down from 79% in 2025 to 73% on-time this year

San Francisco delivered a low cancellation rate of 0.46% and a strong 79.8% OTA rate in 2025. However, with an average OTD of only 73.42%, SFO came in 19th place in the country overall. The airport's design is to blame for recent drops in hourly flight volumes. The FAA revoked the parallel landing exemption that allowed simultaneous operations of its two main arrival runways, which lie only 750 feet (229 meters) apart.

The two strips are 3,550 feet (1,082 meters) below the standard FAA separation limit. That forced the agency to prohibit two aircraft from landing side by side in low clouds. The long-standing exemption ended this March following a broader federal safety review sparked by the January 2025 midair collision of American Airlines Flight 5342 . Thus, when the famous Bay Area fog rolls in, arrival capacity immediately drops from 60 planes per hour down to about 30.

That sudden slowdown forces air traffic controllers to hold flights back at their departure cities across the country, creating ripple-effect delays throughout the day. Once planes finally clear the fog, the cool conditions actually help United's biggest jets take off. Long international flights across the Pacific rely heavily on the Boeing 777-300ER , which can weigh up to 775,000 pounds (351,534 kg) at takeoff when fueled for a transpacific voyage.
Down from 80% in 2025 to 79% on-time this year, so far

United's primary hub for the Southern US and Latin America is Houston Intercontinental. The field handled over 74,200 flights last year, with an 80.6% on-time rate and a low cancellation rate of 0.55%. In terms of punctuality, the airport as a whole rose to sixth position in the country, highlighting how a large hub can still run efficiently when the layout is optimized for high traffic on the ramp.
body_zh: 卢克·迪亚兹 (Luke Diaz) 是一位自由军事作家，拥有在美国海军以及国防和工业工程领域服役的现役经验。他是一名前海军飞行军官，曾在舰载 E-2 鹰眼上执行战术空中控制。
美国联合航空运营着世界上最大的喷气式客机机队，为世界上最广阔、最复杂的航线网络之一提供服务。为了保证国内通勤者和国际旅客的顺利出行，UA 在其顶级枢纽每天约有 4,500 个航班出发，应对恶劣天气、空中交通管制故障和其他意外中断的影响。这个倒计时检查了硬数据，揭示了从西海岸到风城、纽约、孤星州，甚至国家首都的机场的分布情况。
到目前为止，准点率从 2025 年的 73% 下降到 2026 年的 71%
根据 Delay Atlas 的数据，芝加哥奥黑尔机场的准点率 (OTP) 垫底。它是该网络中表现最差的枢纽，只有 73% 的美联航航班能按预期在 2025 年抵达。在中西部夏季雷暴天气期间，紧张的航班时刻表和拥挤的天空很快就会崩溃。与此同时，冬季冰雪构成了另一个季节性天气障碍。该机场今年在美国主要机场中排名约第 24 位。
早上的旅行通常很顺利，但随着时间的推移，延误的情况会迅速增加。去年，近 90% 的凌晨 5:00 至 8:00 之间起飞的航班都准时起飞。在下午 5:00 至晚上 8:00 之间的繁忙晚高峰期间，准点出发 (OTD) 降至 70% 以下。停机坪上的交通堵塞常常迫使抵达的飞机坐在停机坪上等待登机门打开。
所有在地面上的等待都给航空公司和乘客带来了很大的麻烦。一架发动机空转的波音 737 等待起飞时每小时大约燃烧 1,000 至 1,200 磅（454 至 544 公斤）燃油。这些延误甚至可能导致飞行员超出法定工作时间并迫使机组人员调换。在最坏的情况下，旅客可能会因没有托运行李而陷入困境，从而使 ORD 成为美联航行程的最大拖累。
准点率从 2025 年的 76% 上升到今年迄今为止的 79%
去年，美联航取消了 2.3% 的纽瓦克航班，是所有美联航枢纽中取消比例最高的，而且只有 76.3% 的航班准时降落。尽管存在起降时刻限制的声音，但在联邦法规的帮助下，该机场的准点率整体上升至全国第五位。该上限设定了每小时 72 次起飞和降落的上限，但尽管 2026 年 OTD 上升至 79.0%，但 UA 仍然遇到了麻烦。
该机场位于全国最繁忙的空中走廊之一，其运营占地面积很小。狭窄的机场几乎没有犯错的余地。当恶劣天气袭击东海岸时，空中交通就会变得缓慢。那时，联合航空经常不得不直接取消航班，而不是让飞机在空中盘旋。大型跑道建设使情况变得更加紧张，航班暂时减少至每小时 28 架次，并迫使联合航空削减其高峰时刻表，以防止停机坪出现拥堵。
为了在不违反联邦航空局严格的每小时飞行上限的情况下搭载尽可能多的旅客，联合航空使用其最大的喷气式飞机进行国内旅行和海外行程。该航空公司使用波音 777 宽体客机，其重量超过 304,500 磅（138,119 公斤），往返于纽瓦克和旧金山之间。使用一架巨型双通道飞机而不是两架较小的窄体飞机，可以让美联航同时运送数百人，同时节省宝贵的起飞点和登机口空间。
准点率从 2025 年的 79% 下降到今年迄今为止的 76%
到 2025 年，丹佛将有近 108,000 架次航班通过其停机坪，成为美联航最繁忙的枢纽。该航空公司报告称，尽管需求旺盛，但网络最佳取消率仅为 0.41%，准时到达 (OTA) 率高达 78.9%。得益于丹佛慷慨的房地产，空中交通管制还可以比纽瓦克等机场降落和发射更多的飞机，而不会造成地面拥堵。
该机场坐落在广阔的平原上，拥有六条永不重叠的跑道，最大限度地提高了地面运营效率。尽管机场布局非常适合密集的航班，但丹佛的高海拔在夏季带来了天气障碍。海拔 5,434 英尺（1,656 米），空气已经比沿海机场稀薄。在炎热的夏日午后，稀薄而温暖的空气就像在涡轮风扇发动机中的 9,000 英尺（2,743 米）高一样。
低密度和高温使得喷气发动机更难吸入足够的空气来产生起飞推力。在重型波音 737 MAX 上，发动机必须以超过 100% N1 的速度旋转，并且可以将内部排气温度推至接近 1,832°F (1,000°C) 才能起飞。每次出动都会燃烧更多的汽油，并加剧飞机的磨损。
准点率从 2025 年的 79% 下降到今年的 73%
2025 年，旧金山的取消率较低，为 0.46%，而 OTA 率高达 79.8%。然而，SFO 的平均 OTD 仅 73.42%，在全国排名第 19 位。最近每小时航班量下降应归咎于机场的设计。美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 撤销了平行着陆豁免，该豁免允许其两条主进场跑道同时运行，这两条跑道相距仅 750 英尺（229 米）。
这两个地带比 FAA 标准间隔限制低 3,550 英尺（1,082 米）。这迫使该机构禁止两架飞机在低云中并排降落。 2025 年 1 月美国航空 5342 航班空中相撞事件引发了更广泛的联邦安全审查，这项长期豁免于今年 3 月结束。因此，当著名的湾区大雾袭来时，到达航班的容量立即从每小时 60 架飞机降至约 30 架。
航班突然放缓迫使空中交通管制员在全国各地的出发城市暂停航班返航，从而造成全天延误的连锁反应。一旦飞机最终驱散浓雾，凉爽的天气实际上有助于美联航最大的喷气式飞机起飞。跨越太平洋的长途国际航班严重依赖波音 777-300ER，在为跨太平洋航行加油时，起飞时重量可达 775,000 磅（351,534 公斤）。
到目前为止，准点率从 2025 年的 80% 下降到今年的 79%
美联航在美国南部和拉丁美洲的主要枢纽是休斯顿洲际机场。去年，该机场共处理了 74,200 多个航班，准点率达 80.6%，取消率低至 0.55%。在准点率方面，机场整体上升至全国第六位，凸显了在针对坡道高客流量优化布局的情况下，大型枢纽仍能高效运行。

title_en: 5 Injured After 'Severe Turbulence' Hits Fort Lauderdale-Bound JetBlue A320
title_zh: 飞往劳德代尔堡的捷蓝航空 A320 航班遭遇“严重湍流”，造成 5 人受伤
summary: Five people were injured after severe turbulence struck JetBlue Flight 1717, an Airbus A320 flying from Puerto Rico to Fort Lauderdale.
summary_zh: 捷蓝航空 1717 号航班是一架从波多黎各飞往劳德代尔堡的空客 A320 航班，严重湍流导致 5 人受伤。
body_en: Experienced ICAO English Language Proficiency Instructor for pilots and ATCOs and conference interpreter who is passionate about facilitating effective communication within aviation-related businesses. Possess a deep understanding of the aviation industry, including aviation regulations, terminology, and industry-specific communication protocols. Has been working at numerous airshows across Europe since 2014. Being an ultralight pilot in her free time, she also promotes safety and efficiency in aviation operations.

A JetBlue Airbus A320 carrying passengers from Puerto Rico to Florida encountered severe turbulence on November 17, 2026, leaving five people reporting injuries or requiring medical evaluation. Flight 1717, traveling from Ponce Mercedita International Airport (PSE) to Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL), landed safely at approximately 06:58 local time, where emergency personnel were waiting to assist those affected.

The incident involved both passengers and crew members, prompting a response from Broward Sheriff Fire Rescue shortly before the aircraft's arrival. Although five people required medical attention, none were transported to the hospital, and authorities reported no structural damage to the aircraft. The incident is another reminder of the risks turbulence continues to pose to airline passengers and cabin crew, even when flights land safely.
JetBlue A320 Encounters Severe Turbulence On Approach To Fort Lauderdale

JetBlue Flight 1717 was operating between Puerto Rico and Fort Lauderdale earlier today when it encountered severe turbulence. According to AeroInside's aviation incident report , the aircraft was an Airbus A320-200 registered as N524JB. The turbulence reportedly injured several people on board, including passengers and cabin crew members.

Broward Sheriff Fire Rescue received reports of multiple injuries at approximately 06:25 local time, according to information provided to local media. The aircraft subsequently landed safely at approximately 06:58 and proceeded to Terminal 3, where emergency personnel were standing by to assess those affected. Fire rescue officials identified five individuals who either reported injuries or required medical evaluation. All five declined transportation to nearby hospitals, and no patients were taken away from the airport.
JetBlue also confirmed the incident in a statement, explaining that medical personnel assessed passengers and crew members after landing.

"JetBlue flight 1717 from Ponce, Puerto Rico (PSE), to Fort Lauderdale (FLL) experienced turbulence during the flight. The aircraft landed safely, where medical personnel evaluated customers and crewmembers for injuries. No one was transported to a hospital. The safety of our customers and crewmembers remains our top priority."
Thunderstorms Across The Caribbean May Have Contributed To The Turbulence

Although turbulence is routine in commercial aviation, severe encounters can cause serious injuries, especially when passengers or crew members are not securely seated. Sudden changes in an aircraft's movement can throw people against cabin structures, while unsecured service equipment and personal belongings can become dangerous projectiles. Flight attendants are particularly exposed because their duties frequently require them to move around the cabin during flight.

The circumstances surrounding JetBlue's encounter have not been fully established. However, CNN Weather reported that thunderstorms were affecting the Turks and Caicos Islands and the southern Bahamas on Tuesday morning . Storm systems were reportedly reaching altitudes of up to 46,000 feet (14,021 meters), potentially requiring aircraft operating in the region to navigate around particularly intense weather. Other aircraft in the area had also reported light to moderate turbulence.

Importantly, turbulence does not necessarily lead to an aircraft malfunction or structural problem. Modern airliners are designed to withstand substantial aerodynamic forces, and an aircraft can remain structurally sound despite a particularly uncomfortable encounter. In this case, authorities confirmed there were no reports of structural damage after Flight 1717's arrival.

The JetBlue incident follows another serious turbulence-related event involving an Airbus A320 in October 2026. On October 9, an Avianca flight traveling from Medellín, Colombia, to New York's John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) encountered severe turbulence and diverted to Miami International Airport (MIA). Nine people were injured, including six passengers and three crew members, with several requiring hospital treatment. One individual was reportedly taken to a trauma center with serious injuries.

Another significant incident occurred in May 2026, when a Cathay Pacific Airbus A350-900 operating Flight CX156 from Brisbane (BNE) to Hong Kong (HKG) encountered severe turbulence approximately two hours before landing . Ten people were injured, including six cabin crew members and four passengers. Reports described a sudden aircraft drop that reportedly caught passengers during the meal service, highlighting the potential consequences of unexpected turbulence when people are moving around the cabin.

These incidents underline why airlines and aviation authorities continue to emphasize keeping seat belts fastened whenever passengers are seated, even when the seat belt sign has been switched off. While pilots can use weather forecasts, onboard radar and reports from other aircraft to identify potentially turbulent conditions, clear-air turbulence can be particularly difficult to anticipate visually. For JetBlue, Flight 1717's safe arrival meant the incident ended without hospital transportation or reported aircraft damage, although the five reported injuries show that even a relatively short encounter can affect those on board.
body_zh: 经验丰富的国际民航组织飞行员和空中交通管制员英语语言能力讲师以及会议口译员，热衷于促进航空相关业务中的有效沟通。对航空业有深入的了解，包括航空法规、术语和行业特定的通信协议。自 2014 年以来，她一直在欧洲各地的众多航展上工作。作为一名超轻型飞行员，她在业余时间还致力于提高航空运营的安全性和效率。
2026 年 11 月 17 日，一架载有乘客从波多黎各飞往佛罗里达州的捷蓝空客 A320 遭遇严重湍流，导致 5 人受伤或需要医疗评估。 1717 航班从庞塞梅塞迪塔国际机场 (PSE) 飞往劳德代尔堡好莱坞国际机场 (FLL)，于当地时间 06:58 左右安全着陆，紧急救援人员正在等待协助受影响的人员。
该事件涉及乘客和机组人员，促使布劳沃德警长消防救援部门在飞机抵达前不久做出回应。尽管有五人需要医疗救治，但没有人被送往医院，当局报告称飞机没有结构性损坏。这一事件再次提醒人们，即使航班安全着陆，湍流仍然会给航空公司乘客和机组人员带来风险。
捷蓝航空 A320 在接近劳德代尔堡时遭遇严重湍流
今天早些时候，捷蓝航空 1717 号航班在波多黎各和劳德代尔堡之间运营时遇到严重湍流。根据 AeroInside 的航空事故报告，这架飞机是一架空客 A320-200，注册号为 N524JB。据报道，湍流导致机上多人受伤，其中包括乘客和机组人员。
根据当地媒体提供的信息，布劳沃德警长消防救援队于当地时间 06 点 25 分左右收到多人受伤的报告。飞机随后于 06 点 58 分左右安全着陆，并前往 3 号航站楼，应急人员正在那里待命以评估受影响的人员。消防救援官员确认了五名报告受伤或需要医疗评估的人。所有五人都拒绝前往附近医院，也没有患者被带离机场。
捷蓝航空也在一份声明中证实了这一事件，并解释说医务人员在着陆后对乘客和机组人员进行了评估。
“从波多黎各庞塞 (PSE) 飞往劳德代尔堡 (FLL) 的捷蓝航空 1717 号航班在飞行过程中经历了颠簸。飞机安全着陆，医务人员对乘客和机组人员的受伤情况进行了评估。没有人被送往医院。乘客和机组人员的安全仍然是我们的首要任务。”
加勒比地区的雷暴可能是造成湍流的原因
尽管湍流在商业航空中很常见，但严重的遭遇可能会造成严重伤害，特别是当乘客或机组人员没有安全就座时。飞机运动的突然变化可能会将人员抛向机舱结构，而不安全的服务设备和个人物品可能会成为危险的抛射物。空乘人员尤其容易受到影响，因为他们的职责经常要求他们在飞行期间在机舱内走动。
捷蓝航空遭遇事件的具体情况尚未完全确定。然而，美国有线电视新闻网天气报道称，周二上午，雷暴天气影响特克斯和凯科斯群岛以及巴哈马南部地区。据报道，风暴系统的高度高达 46,000 英尺（14,021 米），可能需要在该地区运营的飞机在特别恶劣的天气下航行。该地区的其他飞机也报告有轻度到中度的湍流。
重要的是，湍流不一定会导致飞机故障或结构问题。现代客机的设计能够承受巨大的空气动力，即使遇到特别不舒服的情况，飞机也能保持结构完好。在这起事件中，当局确认 1717 航班抵达后没有收到结构损坏的报告。
捷蓝航空事件是在 2026 年 10 月发生的另一起涉及空客 A320 的严重湍流相关事件之后发生的。10 月 9 日，一架从哥伦比亚麦德林飞往纽约约翰·肯尼迪国际机场 (JFK) 的阿维安卡航班遇到严重湍流，并改道飞往迈阿密国际机场 (MIA)。九人受伤，其中六名乘客和三名机组人员，其中几人需要住院治疗。据报道，一名伤势严重的人被送往创伤中心。
另一起重大事件发生在 2026 年 5 月，当时一架国泰航空空客 A350-900 执飞从布里斯班 (BNE) 飞往香港 (HKG) 的 CX156 航班，在着陆前大约两小时遭遇严重湍流。十人受伤，其中包括六名机组人员和四名乘客。报道称，飞机突然坠落，乘客在用餐期间被困，这凸显了人们在机舱内走动时意外湍流的潜在后果。
这些事件凸显了为什么航空公司和航空当局继续强调乘客就座时要系好安全带，即使安全带指示灯已关闭。虽然飞行员可以使用天气预报、机载雷达和其他飞机的报告来识别潜在的湍流状况，但晴空湍流尤其难以通过视觉预测。对于捷蓝航空来说，1717 航班的安全抵达意味着事件在没有送往医院或报告飞机损坏的情况下结束，尽管报告的五名受伤人员表明，即使是相对短暂的遭遇也会影响机上人员。

title_en: United Airlines Cancels 7 Routes From 3rd Busiest Hub: See Full List Now
title_zh: 美国联合航空取消来自第三繁忙枢纽的 7 条航线：立即查看完整列表
summary: Two international and five routes appear to be gone. Find them here!
summary_zh: 两条国际航线和五条航线似乎消失了。在这里找到他们！
body_en: James lives and breathes route development. Educated in Air Transport Management at Loughborough University and Cranfield University, James has a PhD in Airline Strategy and Economics. James was Market Opportunity Analyst at London Luton Airport and Chief Analyst at anna.aero. He taught airline strategy and economics to undergraduate and postgraduate students for five years and has worked closely with multiple carriers on route and market intelligence projects. He is based near London, UK.

United Airlines is the world's third-largest airline for flights and seats for sale. However, due to the Star Alliance member's strong long-haul operation — it has more long-haul flights than any other operator — it ranks first globally for available seat miles.

United has seven hubs in the mainland US: Chicago O'Hare, Denver , Houston Intercontinental , Los Angeles, Newark, San Francisco, and Washington Dulles. With 948 daily movements, influenced by much regional jet activity, OAG data shows that Houston Intercontinental has the third-highest number of departures.

United's schedule from Houston for January 2026 to March 2027 has been compared to what is planned to operate from next April . This process shows that eight routes have ended or will cease soon, two of which are international . No future flights are scheduled, but this could change. It reflects what is known as of November 17.
All the airline's routes to Tulum are ending . US Department of Transportation (DOT) data shows that Houston had an overall load factor through August 2026 of just 65.6%. No wonder it is ending

The link to Vancouver was served on a year-round basis, often with a double daily operation in the summer and no more than a daily flight in the winter. As no services are scheduled beyond April next year, it is reasonable to assume that it is ending. The 737-800 and 737-900 will be deployed in the remaining months.

Fellow Star Alliance member Air Canada runs daily. The 137-seat A220-300 will operate this winter, with the 196-seat A321 next summer. Perhaps reflecting the absence of United, that'll be the airline's highest-capacity equipment to date.

Flights in what were three brand-new markets do not appear to be returning. Service to Portland, Maine, materialized in June last year, followed by Burlington, Vermont, and Spokane, Washington, in May 2026. In all cases, no nonstop service is scheduled next summer. They only had a Saturday-only operation.

Burlington exclusively saw Mesa's 76-seat Embraer E175s , while Spokane was in the hands of SkyWest's E175s. Portland was a bit different, as mainline A319s coexisted with Mesa E175s. The three routes were United Express's three longest regional jet links from Houston Intercontinental in 2026. At 1,473 nautical miles (2,728 km), Houston-Spokane was the carrier's second-longest RJ route network-wide, after San Francisco-St. Louis.
United From Houston To The 'Biggest Little City in the World'

Covering 1,329 nautical miles (2,461 km), the link from Texas's second-busiest airport to Nevada's second-busiest airport has been served for many years. DOT data shows that Continental inaugurated flights in 1993, but it is possible that they existed before then. They returned in 1998 and operated until 2008, influenced by the Global Financial Crisis. Service resumed in 2011.

In the 12 months to August 2026, DOT data shows that only 10,667 round-trip passengers were transported. That tiny volume was because flights usually only existed on weekends. The load factor was 81.6%, with most passengers (58.1%) only flying between Houston and Reno . It appears that the final departure is set for February 27 on the A319. However, while the route is usually served on a year-round basis, it is possible, but unconfirmed, that it'll become winter-seasonal and return next winter.

title_en: Delta CEO: “Customers Are Not Choosing Airlines Based On Wi-Fi”
title_zh: 达美航空首席执行官：“客户不会根据 Wi-Fi 选择航空公司”
summary: Delta CEO Ed Bastian says customers aren't choosing airlines based on Wi-Fi, while calling Viasat "pretty darn close" to Starlink. After years of hyping connectivity, that's a notable shift.
summary_zh: 达美航空首席执行官埃德·巴斯蒂安 (Ed Bastian) 表示，客户不会根据 Wi-Fi 选择航空公司，同时称 Viasat 与 Starlink“非常接近”。经过多年的炒作
body_en: I’ve gotta be honest, I don’t envy the situation that Delta CEO Ed Bastian is in. Unlike most other carriers in the United States, Delta hasn’t opted for SpaceX Starlink Wi-Fi, and has instead gone with Amazon Leo .

In theory that’s fine, except Amazon Leo is years behind Starlink, and just faced a new setback, due to a rocket failure . Elon Musk has also repeatedly publicly ridiculed Bastian , regarding what Bastian reportedly said about Musk to employees .

There’s now an interesting update, as Bastian made some comments about the carrier’s Wi-Fi choice, and overall customer preferences. It sure is amazing how narratives can change, based on what’s convenient…
Bastian downplays fast Wi-Fi, after hyping it for years

This week at the Fortune 500 Innovation Forum 2026, Delta’s CEO was asked about the carrier’s decision not to choose Starlink, plus the public spat with Musk. Here’s what Bastian had to say about this

“We’ve been the leader in Wi-Fi, and in free and fast Wi-Fi, and we’ve been at it for five years. I’ve got a long history with Elon on that. We’ve looked at Starlink, we actually helped them started in aviation, we gave them our planes to use during COVID, when we weren’t flying, and they tested the system out. We just couldn’t come to agreement on a business model.”

“We’ve been the leader in free, fast Wi-Fi. We are confident there will be more than one LEO product in the world other than Starlink, and I’m confident Amazon has the capability to do a great job. Customers are not choosing airlines based on Wi-Fi. We’ve been out with a great product from Viasat, which we’ve got two new satellites in the sky. It’s not Starlink caliber but it’s pretty darn close.”
“This is about the total experience, and customers are not choosing airlines based on the Wi-Fi.”

At the #F500Innovation Forum, @Delta CEO Ed Bastian told @ajs that the airline helped Elon Musk’s satellite Wi-Fi “get started in aviation,” but the two sides “just couldn’t come to… pic.twitter.com/xmSERJNjjH
What is premium, what is fast, and what is industry leading?
Look, before I get too deep into this, let me make several points that I think no one reasonable will disagree with (which is not to say some commenters won’t disagree!)
Starlink Wi-Fi is better than Viasat, Viasat is better than Panasonic, and then there are a whole bunch of other services
As a passenger who values staying connected, there is a significant difference between Starlink and Viasat, whether you’re looking to be productive or entertained
A vast majority of passengers don’t choose an airline exclusively based on the Wi-Fi, but rather, it’s about the overall value (factoring in price, schedule, loyalty, and product)

As someone who has been flying frequently since inflight Wi-Fi was introduced, the standard of what’s considered “fast” Wi-Fi has changed massively; at one point Viasat felt lightning fast, when the reference point was otherwise OnAir, or another lesser service
When Bastian formally unveiled plans for free Wi-Fi at CES 2023 in Las Vegas, he said the following

“At work, at home and everywhere in between, connectivity is essential to daily life, and your journey on Delta should be no different. Our vision has long been to deliver an experience at 30,000 feet that feels similar to what our customers have available on the ground.”

“We didn’t just want free Wi-Fi to offer base-level service – we wanted it to be transformative for the entire onboard experience. It is imperative all customers onboard can enjoy their favorite content just as they would at home, and we’ve put this system through meticulous tests to make that possible.”

Based on what we know as of now, there will be an extended period of time around a year from now where United will massively overtake Delta when it comes to Wi-Fi speed and quality, and that advantage will last for years; heck, Delta has only committed to introducing Amazon Leo on under half its fleet, once the service goes live in 2028, best case scenario
Unless your Wi-Fi router at home is broken, Viasat simply doesn’t offer comparable quality connectivity to what you have at home, which Bastian insists is imperative
body_zh: 说实话，我并不羡慕达美航空首席执行官埃德·巴斯蒂安（Ed Bastian）的处境。与美国大多数其他航空公司不同，达美航空没有选择 SpaceX Starlink Wi-Fi，而是选择了 Amazon Leo。
从理论上讲，这没什么问题，只是亚马逊 Leo 落后 Starlink 好几年了，而且刚刚由于火箭故障而面临新的挫折。埃隆·马斯克还多次公开嘲笑巴斯蒂安，因为据报道巴斯蒂安对员工谈到了马斯​​克。
现在有一个有趣的更新，巴斯蒂安对运营商的 Wi-Fi 选择和总体客户偏好发表了一些评论。令人惊奇的是，叙事可以根据方便的方式而改变……
巴斯蒂安在大肆宣传多年后淡化了快速 Wi-Fi
本周在 2026 年财富 500 强创新论坛上，达美航空首席执行官被问及该航空公司不选择星链的决定，以及与马斯克的公开争吵。这是巴斯蒂安对此不得不说的
“我们一直是 Wi-Fi 以及免费快速 Wi-Fi 领域的领导者，我们在这方面已经有五年了。我和 Elon 在这方面有着悠久的历史。我们研究了 Starlink，我们实际上帮助他们开始了航空业，我们在新冠疫情期间，当我们不飞行时，给了他们我们的飞机供他们使用，他们测试了系统。我们只是无法就商业模式达成一致。”
“我们一直是免费、快速 Wi-Fi 领域的领导者。我们相信，除了 Starlink 之外，世界上还会有不止一种 LEO 产品，而且我相信亚马逊有能力做得很好。客户不会根据 Wi-Fi 选择航空公司。我们已经推出了 Viasat 的一款出色产品，我们在天空中安装了两颗新卫星。虽然不是 Starlink 口径，但也非常接近了。”
“这关乎整体体验，客户不会根据 Wi-Fi 选择航空公司。”
在 #F500 创新论坛上，@达美航空首席执行官埃德·巴斯蒂安 (Ed Bastian) 告诉 @ajs，该航空公司帮助埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的卫星 Wi-Fi “在航空领域起步”，但双方“就是无法达成一致…… pic.twitter.com/xmSERJNjjH
什么是优质、什么是快速、什么是行业领先？
看，在我深入探讨这个问题之前，让我先提出几点我认为任何有理性的人都不会不同意的观点（这并不是说一些评论者不会不同意！）
Starlink Wi-Fi 比 Viasat 好，Viasat 比松下好，还有一大堆其他服务
作为重视保持联系的乘客，无论您想要提高工作效率还是获得娱乐，Starlink 和 Viasat 之间都存在显着差异
绝大多数乘客不会仅仅根据 Wi-Fi 选择航空公司，而是考虑整体价值（考虑价格、航班时刻表、忠诚度和产品）
对于自从机上 Wi-Fi 推出以来经常乘坐飞机的人来说，“快速”Wi-Fi 的标准已经发生了巨大变化；有一次，当参考点是 OnAir 或其他较小的服务时，Viasat 感觉快如闪电
当巴斯蒂安 (Bastian) 在拉斯维加斯 CES 2023 上正式公布免费 Wi-Fi 计划时，他说道：
“无论是在工作中、在家里还是在其他任何地方，互联互通对于日常生活至关重要，您的达美之旅也应该如此。长期以来，我们的愿景是在 30,000 英尺的高空提供与客户在地面上体验相似的体验。”
“我们不仅仅希望免费 Wi-Fi 提供基本水平的服务，我们希望它能够为整个机上体验带来变革。机上的所有乘客都必须像在家里一样享受自己喜欢的内容，我们已经对该系统进行了细致的测试，以实现这一点。”
根据我们目前所知，在大约一年后的一段时间内，联合航空将在 Wi-Fi 速度和质量方面大幅超越达美航空，并且这种优势将持续数年；哎呀，达美航空只承诺在 2028 年该服务上线后，在其不到一半的机队中引入 Amazon Leo（最好的情况）
除非您家里的 Wi-Fi 路由器坏了，否则 Viasat 根本无法提供与您家里的质量相当的连接，巴斯蒂安坚持认为这是必要的

title_en: Frontier Cancels Massive 17 International Routes: See Full List Now
title_zh: Frontier 大规模取消 17 条国际航线：立即查看完整列表
summary: A sudden rework of Frontier’s overseas map has cut several leisure gateways.
summary_zh: Frontier 的海外地图突然重做，切断了几条休闲通道。
body_en: Journalist – Aaron is an aviation and travel journalist with 14 years of experience in the travel and tourism industry. His background spans airport operations, aviation infrastructure, and travel consulting, having worked with global organizations across New Zealand, Europe, and North America.

Combining industry expertise with firsthand travel experience across more than 52 countries and five continents, Aaron covers airlines, airports, aviation policy, and the wider travel sector. He is based in Canterbury, New Zealand.
His work has been published in Simple Flying and featured by MSN, SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel, EIN News, Pakistan Defence, and Climate Depot.

Denver-based Frontier Airlines has rapidly cut a total of 16 international routes from its network this year, with Atlanta (ATL), one of the airline's major bases, losing a total of eight routes overall. These network changes have taken place between March and August 2026.

Data from Cirium , an aviation analytics company, shows that the budget airline has reconfigured its international operations. It is redeploying aircraft on more lucrative domestic or other international routes following a difficult year for airlines in the face of high fuel prices and other operational demands. This data has been reviewed against 2026 and 2027 flight schedules.
Frontier Airlines Has Cut Eight International Routes From Atlanta

Frontier is the second-largest operator at Atlanta. However, it is still just a marginal player when compared to Delta, which calls Atlanta home. Frontier operates around 6% of all flights from Atlanta, according to the airport's website . The airline trimmed eight nonstop international routes from the airport in April of this year.

These affected services to Puerto Vallarta (PVR), San José del Cabo (SJD), Santo Domingo (SDQ), Nassau (NAS), Aruba (AUA), Providenciales (PLS), St Maarten (SXM), and San Pedro Sula (SAP). This leaves Frontier with a network of 40 domestic and six year-round international destinations from Atlanta .

The remaining five year-round services from Atlanta to Cancún (CUN), Guatemala City (GUA), Montego Bay (MBJ), San José, Costa Rica (SJO), and San Salvador (SAL). There is also a seasonal link to Punta Cana (PUJ).

Earlier this year, Denver (DEN) lost two international services served by Frontier. The airline withdrew its operations to San José del Cabo (SJD) from the Colorado airport in March, while Denver to Puerto Vallarta (PVR) lost its international link in April. This was followed by Charlotte (CLT) also losing its international route to Cancún (CUN) after the airline pulled service on the city pair in April.

This leaves the airline with no international routes from Charlotte. Now, it only has domestic flights to Baltimore (BWI), Chicago–O'Hare (ORD), Dallas/Fort Worth (DFW), Denver, Detroit (DTW), Fort Lauderdale (FLL), Houston–Intercontinental (IAH), Miami (MIA), New York–LaGuardia (LGA), Orlando (MCO), Philadelphia (PHL), San Juan (SJU), and Tampa (TPA).
Frontier's international route from Raleigh/Durham (RDU) to Cancún was also lost in May. Meanwhile, Orlando's link to St Maarten (SXM) was axed in summer, after the airline pulled the pin in August.

The decision to consolidate a number of international routes was also seen in both Chicago and Miami, with Frontier terminating two services from each city. Chicago Midway (MDW) lost its service to Cancún in April, while O'Hare (ORD) lost its link to Punta Cana (PUJ) in the Dominican Republic .

This leaves Frontier with 23 domestic routes from O'Hare, and a further nine domestic routes from Midway. Frontier is the second-largest airline at Chicago Midway, the city's second busiest airport after O'Hare. While Southwest operates more than 91% of all flights at Midway, Frontier served over half a million passengers between June 2025 and May 2026, accounting for 3% of all traffic.
Found an error? Send it info@simpleflying.com so it can be corrected.

Miami (MIA) is the final airport to have lost Frontier international services in this analysis, with the airline cutting international flights to Santo Domingo (SDQ) and San Salvador (SAL). Both cuts were made in April. These leave the Florida airport with 20 domestic year-round services by the airline and three international routes, which include Guatemala City (GUA) served year-round and two seasonal links to Punta Cana and San Pedro Sula.
body_zh: 记者 – Aaron 是一名航空和旅行记者，在旅行和旅游业拥有 14 年的经验。他的背景涵盖机场运营、航空基础设施和旅游咨询，曾与新西兰、欧洲和北美的全球组织合作。
Aaron 将行业专业知识与五大洲超过 52 个国家/地区的第一手旅行经验相结合，涵盖航空公司、机场、航空政策和更广泛的旅行领域。他居住在新西兰坎特伯雷。
他的作品发表在《Simple Flying》上，并受到 MSN、SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel、EIN News、Pakistan Defence 和 Climate Depot 的专题报道。
总部位于丹佛的边疆航空今年已迅速削减其网络中的 16 条国际航线，其中该航空公司的主要基地之一亚特兰大 (ATL) 总共损失了 8 条航线。这些网络变化发生在 2026 年 3 月至 8 月期间。
航空分析公司 Cirium 的数据显示，这家廉价航空公司已经重新配置了其国际业务。面对高油价和其他运营需求，航空公司经历了艰难的一年，该公司正在将飞机重新部署到利润更丰厚的国内或其他国际航线上。该数据已根据 2026 年和 2027 年的航班时刻表进行审查。
边疆航空削减了 8 条从亚特兰大出发的国际航线
Frontier 是亚特兰大第二大运营商。然而，与以亚特兰大为基地的达美航空相比，它仍然只是一个边缘参与者。根据机场网站，Frontier 运营着约 6% 的从亚特兰大起飞的航班。今年 4 月，该航空公司削减了 8 条从该机场出发的直飞国际航线。
这些受影响的航班包括巴亚尔塔港 (PVR)、圣何塞德尔卡波 (SJD)、圣多明各 (SDQ)、拿骚 (NAS)、阿鲁巴 (AUA)、普罗维登夏莱斯 (PLS)、圣马丁 (SXM) 和圣佩德罗苏拉 (SAP)。这使得 Frontier 拥有由亚特兰大出发的 40 个国内目的地和 6 个全年国际目的地组成的网络。
其余五个全年航班从亚特兰大飞往坎昆 (CUN)、危地马拉城 (GUA)、蒙特哥湾 (MBJ)、哥斯达黎加圣何塞 (SJO) 和圣萨尔瓦多 (SAL)。还有前往蓬塔卡纳 (PUJ) 的季节性航班。
今年早些时候，丹佛 (DEN) 失去了 Frontier 提供的两条国际航班服务。该航空公司于 3 月份撤回了从科罗拉多机场飞往圣何塞德尔卡波 (SJD) 的航班，而丹佛飞往巴亚尔塔港 (PVR) 的航班于 4 月份失去了国际航线。随后，夏洛特 (CLT) 航空公司在 4 月份取消了飞往坎昆 (CUN) 的国际航线后，也失去了这两个城市的航班。
这使得该航空公司没有从夏洛特出发的国际航线。目前，该公司仅运营飞往巴尔的摩 (BWI)、芝加哥 - 奥黑尔 (ORD)、达拉斯/沃斯堡 (DFW)、丹佛、底特律 (DTW)、劳德代尔堡 (FLL)、休斯顿 - 洲际 (IAH)、迈阿密 (MIA)、纽约 - 拉瓜迪亚 (LGA)、奥兰多 (MCO)、费城 (PHL)、圣胡安 (SJU) 和坦帕 (TPA) 的国内航班。
Frontier 从罗利/达勒姆 (RDU) 飞往坎昆的国际航线也在五月中断。与此同时，奥兰多与圣马丁岛 (SXM) 的航线在该航空公司于 8 月取消后于夏季被取消。
芝加哥和迈阿密也做出了整合多条国际航线的决定，Frontier 终止了每个城市的两条航班服务。芝加哥中途机场 (MDW) 于 4 月失去了飞往坎昆的航班，而奥黑尔机场 (ORD) 则失去了飞往多米尼加共和国蓬塔卡纳 (PUJ) 的航班。
这使得 Frontier 拥有 23 条从奥黑尔出发的国内航线，以及另外 9 条从中途岛出发的国内航线。边疆航空公司是芝加哥中途机场的第二大航空公司，芝加哥中途机场是该市仅次于奥黑尔机场的第二繁忙机场。西南航空运营着中途岛机场 91% 以上的航班，而边疆航空在 2025 年 6 月至 2026 年 5 月期间为超过 50 万名乘客提供服务，占总运输量的 3%。
发现错误？将其发送至 info@simpleflying.com 以便进行更正。
迈阿密 (MIA) 是本次分析中最后一个失去边疆国际服务的机场，该航空公司削减了飞往圣多明各 (SDQ) 和圣萨尔瓦多 (SAL) 的国际航班。两次削减都是在四月份进行的。从佛罗里达机场出发，该航空公司全年提供 20 条国内航班和 3 条国际航线，其中包括全年运营的危地马拉城 (GUA) 以及两条季节性飞往蓬塔卡纳和圣佩德罗苏拉的航班。

title_en: T-19A Kestrel: Meet The US Air Force Academy's New Unlimited Aerobatic Aircraft For Cadets
title_zh: T-19A Kestrel：美国空军学院为学员打造的新型无限特技飞行器
summary: The USAFA gets a major upgrade to the flightline to train the next generation of aviators.
summary_zh: 美国空军协会对航线进行了重大升级，以培训下一代飞行员。
body_en: Luke Diaz is a freelance military writer with experience with active duty experience in the US Navy as well as defense and industrial engineering. He is a former Naval Flight Officer who performed tactical air control on the carrier-based E-2 Hawkeye.

On November 12, four new composite planes swept low over the Cadet Wing assembled at the US Air Force Academy in Colorado. The flight marked the official arrival of the T-19A Kestrel light trainer at Davis Airfield in Colorado Springs. Instead of wading through decades of defense bureaucracy and drawn-out congressional appropriations, USAFA secured its next-generation aerobatic aircraft in just 10 months, cutting through red tape with the help of a private donor group led by Andrew McKenna.

The T-19A is a derivative of the commercial GB1 GameBird. By skipping the traditional procurement, leadership bypassed the budget overruns and timeline slips that have paralyzed programs like the Boeing T-7A Red Hawk. The lightweight plane is purpose-built for agility thanks to its designer, German aerobatic champion Philipp Steinbach. He is a co-founder of Game Aerospace Composites in Bentonville, Arkansas, which produces the off-the-shelf civilian variant certified to pull a staggering load of ten G-forces.

The Kestrel went from concept to delivery in 10 months using $3 million in private donations, whereas the Red Hawk has spent over a decade in development using billions in taxpayer funds and still faces multi-year delays. The T-19A will fill a major gap in modern USAFA flight training by giving cadets early exposure to high-G, unlimited aerobatics and complex energy management before they ever step into Undergraduate Pilot Training.
Fast-Tracking Fighter Skills: Inside the Air Force Academy’s New 10-G Trainer

The T-19A, or GB1 GameBird, is the only American-built two-seat aircraft approved for Unlimited-category competition aerobatics. Its all-carbon monocoque airframe lacks traditional mechanical wing-attach joints, relying on a continuous composite spar cured inside an autoclave. This gives the plane an operating empty weight of roughly 1,290 pounds (585 kg) while enabling symmetric flight loads of up to 10-G at its aerobatic maximum limit.

Under the hood, a 583-cubic-inch Lycoming AEIO-580-B1A flat-six piston engine delivers 303 horsepower (226 kW) to a four-blade composite MT-Propeller system. An inverted oil and fuel system keeps the engine running under sustained negative-g flight and zero-g push-overs. Cadets command the airframe from tandem seats equipped with Garmin G3X Touch glass displays, combining edge-of-envelope stick-and-rudder forces with modern electronic flight screens before stepping into standard turboprops.

To make the transition, USAFA pulled six active-duty instructor pilots from the 306th Flying Training Group to stand up the first training cadre. These officers will shape a new syllabus to train cadets and establish a demonstration and competition team. The initiative comes as the wider military struggles with a persistent shortfall of roughly 2,000 operational pilots, forcing leadership to seek shortcuts to build stick-and-rudder skills earlier in pilot development .
Private Donors Deliver An Unlimited Aerobatic Trainer To The Air Force's Next Generation Of Pilots

The Academy's existing fleet jumps from unpowered TG-16A gliders and basic T-53A/T-41D piston trainers straight to the UPT's T-6A Texan II turboprops after graduation. USAF Chief of Staff General Ken Wilsbach and Academy Superintendent Lt. Gen. Paul Moga secured the four airframes thanks to a $3 million donation coordinated by philanthropist Andrew McKenna. Meanwhile, the USAFA paid $400,000 in operational funds for initial tooling, spares, and flight gear, along with a projected annual operating budget of $1 million to maintain the fleet.

The Kestrel will act as an intermediate high-performance step, teaching cadets how to manage high power-to-weight ratios, rapid throttle response, and aggressive energy management . Standard trainers are built for stability and prohibit extreme maneuvers. Because the Kestrel is certified for unlimited aerobatics, instructors can deliberately put cadets into inverted spins, vertical stalls, and disorienting attitudes, teaching them instinctive recovery skills that directly prevent real-world loss-of-control accidents.

The Air Force is facing a persistent pilot deficit and needs to push students through UPT faster without lowering standards. By giving top cadets advanced stick-and-rudder proficiency during their junior and senior years at the Academy, they arrive at UPT needing fewer remedial rides and moving through the syllabus faster. Additionally, building an aerobatic competition team around the Kestrel will push the selected cadets to fly under public scrutiny with the precision and discipline they will further refine in operational flying squadrons.
A Mile-High Airfield: The Challenge Of Air Training In Colorado Springs

Operating the Kestrel at the USAFA in Colorado Springs comes with real performance trade-offs. The Academy's Davis Airfield sits at an elevation of 6,572 feet (2,003 meters), and summer heat often makes the air feel like it is over 9,000 feet (2,743 meters). That means the T-19A's non-turbocharged engine loses roughly 22% to 26% of its power. That thinner mountain air requires longer takeoff runs and leaves pilots with less excess engine power during demanding maneuvers.

Weight limits create another hurdle for daily operations, as the Kestrel can weigh up to 2,200 pounds (998 kg) for standard point-to-point flights. Its maximum takeoff rating for extreme 10-G aerobatics only applies at 1,940 pounds (880 kg) or less. Subtracting the plane's 1,290-pound (585 kg) empty weight leaves just 650 pounds (295 kg) for people, gear, and fuel. Once an instructor and a cadet strap in, only enough weight allowance remains for 25 to 30 gallons (95 to 114 liters) of fuel.

That limits intense flights to roughly 45 minutes, requiring ground crews to refuel and turn the planes around quickly between sorties. Moving cadets from unpowered gliders into a 200-knot (370 km/h) airplane is also a major operational adjustment. Because rapid spins and heavy G-forces can easily cause motion sickness or make new pilots lose track of which way is up, instructors must design a step-by-step program that gradually introduces cadets to the plane's capabilities.
Outclassing Legacy Trainers And Competition Aerobats

Built entirely from carbon fiber, the T-19A brings modern composite design to a general aviation field long dominated by traditional steel-tube frames. Even compared to the newer carbon-fiber Extra NG, the Kestrel weighs about 110 pounds (50 kg) less at an empty weight of 1,290 pounds (585 kg). Its wing and fuselage tanks also hold 81 gallons (307 liters) of fuel, giving it a cross-country range of over 1,000 nautical miles (1,852 kilometers).
body_zh: 卢克·迪亚兹 (Luke Diaz) 是一位自由军事作家，拥有在美国海军以及国防和工业工程领域服役的现役经验。他是一名前海军飞行军官，曾在舰载 E-2 鹰眼上执行战术空中控制。
11 月 12 日，四架新型复合材料飞机低空掠过在科罗拉多州美国空军学院组装的学员联队上空。此次飞行标志着 T-19A Kestrel 轻型教练机正式抵达科罗拉多斯普林斯的戴维斯机场。在安德鲁·麦肯纳 (Andrew McKenna) 领导的私人捐助团体的帮助下，美国空军没有费力地经历数十年的国防官僚作风和旷日持久的国会拨款，而是在短短 10 个月内就获得了下一代特技飞机，消除了繁文缛节。

T-19A 是商用 GB1 GameBird 的衍生产品。通过跳过传统采购，领导层避开了导致波音 T-7A 红鹰等项目陷入瘫痪的预算超支和时间延误问题。这架轻型飞机是专为敏捷性而设计的，这要归功于其设计师、德国特技飞行冠军菲利普·斯坦巴赫 (Philipp Steinbach)。他是位于阿肯色州本顿维尔的 Game Aerospace Composites 公司的联合创始人，该公司生产现成的民用变体，经认证可承受 10 倍 G 力的惊人负载。
Kestrel 从概念到交付仅用了 10 个月的时间，使用了 300 万美元的私人捐款，而 Red Hawk 则花费了十多年的时间进行开发，使用了数十亿纳税人的资金，并且仍然面临多年的延误。 T-19A 将填补现代 USAFA 飞行训练的一个重大空白，让学员在进入本科飞行员训练之前尽早接触高重力、无限特技飞行和复杂的能量管理。
快速跟踪战斗机技能：空军学院新型 10-G 教练机内部
T-19A（或 GB1 GameBird）是美国制造的唯一获准进行无限类别竞赛特技飞行的两座飞机。其全碳硬壳式机身没有传统的机械机翼连接接头，而是依靠在高压釜内固化的连续复合材料翼梁。这使得飞机的空运行重量约为 1,290 磅（585 千克），同时在特技飞行最大极限下对称飞行载荷高达 10 G。
在引擎盖下，一台 583 立方英寸的莱康明 AEIO-580-B1A 平置六活塞发动机为四叶片复合材料 MT 螺旋桨系统提供 303 马力（226 千瓦）的功率。倒置的油和燃油系统使发动机在持续的负重力飞行和零重力推力下保持运行。学员们在配备 Garmin G3X Touch 玻璃显示器的串联座椅上指挥机身，在进入标准涡轮螺旋桨飞机之前，将极限的操纵杆和方向舵力与现代电子飞行屏幕相结合。
为了实现这一转变，美国空军从第 306 飞行训练大队抽调了 6 名现役教官飞行员来担任第一批培训干部。这些官员将制定新的教学大纲来培训学员并建立一支示范和竞赛队。这一举措出台之际，正值更广泛的军事斗争中，大约 2,000 名作战飞行员持续短缺，迫使领导层寻求捷径，在飞行员发展的早期阶段培养操纵杆和方向舵的技能。
私人捐助者为空军下一代飞行员提供无限特技飞行训练器

学院现有的机队毕业后从无动力的 TG-16A 滑翔机和基本的 T-53A/T-41D 活塞教练机直接升级到 UPT 的 T-6A Texan II 涡轮螺旋桨飞机。美国空军参谋长肯·威尔斯巴赫将军和学院院长保罗·莫加中将在慈善家安德鲁·麦肯纳协调下捐赠了 300 万美元，确保了这四架机身的安全。与此同时，美国空军为初始工具、备件和飞行装备支付了 40 万美元的运营资金，以及用于维护机队的预计年度运营预算 100 万美元。
Kestrel 将充当中间高性能步骤，教导学员如何管理高功率重量比、快速油门响应和积极的能量管理。标准训练器专为稳定性而设计，并禁止极端操作。由于 Kestrel 获得了无限特技飞行认证，教练可以故意让学员进行倒转、垂直失速和迷失方向的姿势，教他们本能的恢复技能，从而直接防止现实世界中的失控事故。
空军面临着持续的飞行员短缺问题，需要在不降低标准的情况下推动学生更快地完成 UPT。通过在学院三年级和四年级期间为顶尖学员提供先进的操纵杆和方向舵熟练程度，他们到达 UPT 时需要更少的补习骑行，并更快地完成教学大纲。此外，围绕红隼建立一支特技飞行比赛队将促使选定的学员在公众监督下飞行，其精确性和纪律性将在飞行中队中进一步完善。
一英里高的机场：科罗拉多斯普林斯空中训练的挑战
在科罗拉多斯普林斯的 USAFA 操作 Kestrel 需要进行真正的性能权衡。学院的戴维斯机场海拔 6,572 英尺（2,003 米），夏季的炎热常常使空气感觉超过 9,000 英尺（2,743 米）。这意味着 T-19A 的非涡轮增压发动机损失大约 22% 到 26% 的功率。山地空气稀薄，需要更长的起飞距离，并且在要求较高的机动过程中，飞行员的多余发动机功率也较少。

重量限制给日常运营带来了另一个障碍，因为标准点对点航班的 Kestrel 重量可达 2,200 磅（998 公斤）。极限 10 G 特技飞行的最大起飞额定值仅适用于 1,940 磅（880 公斤）或更小。减去飞机 1,290 磅（585 公斤）的空重，只剩下 650 磅（295 公斤）的人员、装备和燃料。一旦教练和学员系好安全带，重量就只剩下足够 25 至 30 加仑（95 至 114 升）燃油的重量了。
这将密集的飞行时间限制在大约 45 分钟，要求地勤人员在每次飞行之间加油并快速调转飞机。将学员从无动力滑翔机转移到时速 200 节（370 公里/小时）的飞机上也是一项重大的操作调整。由于快速旋转和沉重的重力很容易导致晕动病或使新飞行员忘记方向，因此教练必须设计一个循序渐进的计划，逐步向学员介绍飞机的功能。
超越传统教练机和竞赛飞行器
T-19A 完全由碳纤维制成，将现代复合材料设计带入长期由传统钢管框架主导的通用航空领域。即使与较新的碳纤维 Extra NG 相比，Kestrel 的重量也轻了约 110 磅（50 公斤），空重为 1,290 磅（585 公斤）。其机翼和机身油箱还可容纳 81 加仑（307 升）燃油，使其越野航程超过 1,000 海里（1,852 公里）。

title_en: Tulum Is Losing Airlines Fast: Why The Hyped New Airport Is Failing
title_zh: 图卢姆正在快速失去航空公司：为什么大肆宣传的新机场却失败了
summary: Tulum's Felipe Carrillo Puerto Airport opened in late 2023, but airlines like JetBlue, Avianca, and Copa have left, and passenger numbers are down 33.2% so far in 2026.
summary_zh: 图卢姆的 Felipe Carrillo Puerto 机场于 2023 年底开业，但捷蓝航空 (JetBlue)、哥伦比亚航空 (Avianca) 和巴拿马航空 (Copa) 等航空公司已经离开，乘客人数减少了 33 人。
body_en: In late 2023, we saw the opening of the Felipe Carrillo Puerto International Airport (TQO) , in Tulum, Mexico. For those not familiar, Tulum is located on the eastern coast of the Yucatan Peninsula, and for years, it was a growing tourist destination.

While it could previously be accessed via Cancun International Airport (CUN), the hope was that by opening a new international airport, visitor numbers would expand massively. Unfortunately what has actually happened is exactly the opposite, as airline after airline has pulled out. What exactly is going on here? I think it makes for an interesting story , and thanks to TravelinWilly for flagging this.
Airlines are abandoning Tulum, one after the other

In 2023, we saw airline after airline announce flights to Tulum. Among US carriers, we saw American, Delta, JetBlue, and United, all launch flights to Tulum, while Spirit announced flights, but never launched them.

That was only a small part of the overall international service to the airport, as we also saw flights to Tulum on Air Canada, Air Transat, Avianca, Copa, Discover, and WestJet, along with flights on domestic carriers like Aeromexico, Mexicana de Aviacion, Viva, and Volaris.

Less than three years after the airport opened, where do things stand? When it comes to international year-round service, we’ve now gone from service to 12 airports, to service to four airports, which is an absolutely massive reduction
Among US carriers, the only ones that are left are American and Delta, while JetBlue has already pulled out, and United has announced it will pull out as of early 2027
That also says nothing of how Avianca, Copa, and Discover, have pulled out, while Canadian carriers now only operate seasonal service
And we also won’t even get into how Aeromexico has abandoned the airport, though admittedly that was just domestic service

Just to put this into numbers, in the first half of 2026, the airport saw a 33.2% reduction in passengers. June 2026 was the worst month to date, with a 44.8% drop, as there were just 47,600 passengers, compared to 86,200 passengers the year prior.
It goes without saying that for a newly built airport, this is rather catastrophic, and not what you hope to see.

In some ways, it feels like the whole concept behind Tulum Airport was sort of unnecessary. That’s also easily explained by the fact that the airport was well over a decade in the making, so while I can see how it might’ve seemed like a good idea at some point, tourism trends do evolve over time.

The reality is that there was a point where Tulum was cool, edgy, and a bit off the beaten path, compared to… whatever it is now. But when it comes to the struggles that airlines have had with flying to Tulum, it seems like the problems have been endless

The United States is the largest inbound tourism market for Mexico, and overall demand for travel to Mexico among Americans is down; in the first half of 2026, Mexico’s share of American trips dropped from 19.8% to 18.1%, so it’s a shrinking market at the moment

That’s not great when paired with the fact that Mexico has seen a massive amount of growth when it comes to new hotels in places like Cancun, Los Cabos, etc., so despite visitor numbers being down, there’s increasing competition for those fewer visitors
Cancun has also seen an explosion in new resorts, and that’s some pretty direct competition, especially when you consider how much more easily accessible it is from a lot of destinations

The Maya Train (connecting Cancun and Tulum) opened around the same time as the airport, making travel between the two places easy and affordable; arguably that reduces the need for a dedicated airport, rather than creating the need for one

Tulum has seen a decrease in visitors, as it has sort of lost its “cool” factor, and it has also seen an issue with sargassum; in the first six months of 2026, hotel occupancy in Tulum averaged 63.7%, compared to 72.7% the year before

Mexico in general is suffering from the fact that it’s no longer really a value destination, at least for those looking for luxury experiences; prices are really high, and when you add in the taxes & service charges, prices start to look a whole lot like in the United States
Tulum Airport offered incentives for airlines to launch service there, but those incentives were reduced year by year, with almost everything running out after three years (which coincides with now!)
body_zh: 2023 年底，墨西哥图卢姆费利佩·卡里洛·波多黎各国际机场 (TQO) 投入运营。对于那些不熟悉的人来说，图卢姆位于尤卡坦半岛的东海岸，多年来，它一直是一个不断发展的旅游目的地。
虽然以前可以通过坎昆国际机场 (CUN) 到达，但希望通过开设新的国际机场，游客数量将大幅增加。不幸的是，实际发生的情况恰恰相反，多家航空公司纷纷退出。这里究竟发生了什么？我认为这是一个有趣的故事，感谢 TravelinWilly 对此进行了标记。
航空公司纷纷放弃图卢姆
2023 年，我们看到多家航空公司宣布飞往图卢姆的航班。在美国航空公司中，我们看到美国航空、达美航空、捷蓝航空和联合航空都开通了飞往图卢姆的航班，而精神航空虽然宣布了航班，但从未开通。
这只是机场整体国际服务的一小部分，因为我们还看到了加拿大航空、越洋航空、阿维安卡航空、巴拿马航空、Discover 和西捷航空飞往图卢姆的航班，以及墨西哥航空、墨西哥航空、Viva 和 Volaris 等国内航空公司的航班。
机场开业不到三年，情况又如何呢？说到国际全年服务，我们现在从服务 12 个机场，减少到服务 4 个机场，这绝对是一个巨大的减少
美国航空公司中，只剩下美国航空和达美航空，而捷蓝航空已经退出，美联航也宣布将于 2027 年初退出
这也没有说明 Avianca、Copa 和 Discover 是如何退出的，而加拿大航空公司现在只运营季节性航班
我们甚至不会了解墨西哥航空如何放弃机场，尽管诚然这只是国内服务
从数字上看，2026年上半年，机场旅客减少了33.2%。 2026 年 6 月是迄今为止最糟糕的月份，下降了 44.8%，旅客数量仅为 47,600 人，而上年为 86,200 人。
不言而喻，对于一个新建的机场来说，这是相当灾难性的，不是你所希望看到的。
从某些方面来说，图卢姆机场背后的整个概念似乎是不必要的。这也很容易解释，因为机场的建设已经有十多年了，所以虽然我可以看到它在某些时候看起来是个好主意，但旅游趋势确实随着时间的推移而演变。
事实是，与现在相比，图卢​​姆曾一度很酷、前卫，而且有点偏僻。但当谈到航空公司在飞往图卢姆的航班时遇到的困难时，问题似乎无穷无尽
美国是墨西哥最大的入境旅游市场，美国人赴墨西哥旅游整体需求下降； 2026年上半年，墨西哥在美国旅游中的占比从19.8%下降至18.1%，目前市场正在萎缩
考虑到墨西哥坎昆、洛斯卡沃斯等地的新酒店数量大幅增长，这一点并不好，因此尽管游客数量有所下降，但对那些较少游客的竞争却越来越激烈
坎昆也出现了新度假村的爆炸式增长，这是一些相当直接的竞争，尤其是当你考虑到从很多目的地到达这里是多么容易时
玛雅火车（连接坎昆和图卢姆）与机场大约在同一时间开通，使两地之间的旅行变得轻松且经济实惠；可以说，这减少了对专用机场的需求，而不是创造了一个专用机场的需求
图卢姆的游客数量有所减少，因为它已经失去了“酷”的因素，而且还出现了马尾藻问题； 2026 年前六个月，图卢姆酒店平均入住率为 63.7%，而上年为 72.7%
墨西哥总体上正面临着这样一个事实：它不再是一个真正的价值目的地，至少对于那些寻求奢华体验的人来说是这样。价格确实很高，当你加上税费和服务费时，价格开始看起来很像美国
图伦机场为航空公司提供了在该机场推出服务的激励措施，但这些激励措施逐年减少，三年后几乎所有的东西都用完了（与现在一致！）
